data.jd_text:
We are seeking an AI PMO Manager to design and shape enterprise AI and automation use cases across finance and wider business functions. The role focuses on identifying high\-value opportunities, defining solution approaches, and guiding build vs buy decisions to maximise ROI. It combines strong technical literacy with business transformation experience, acting as an architect for AI\-enabled change rather than a delivery coder or large\-scale programme owner.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Identify and prioritise AI, GenAI, ML, and automation opportunities across the enterprise
* Translate business problems into structured, high\-ROI use cases and delivery roadmaps
* Define solution approaches across AI agents, ML, GenAI, RPA, and supporting infrastructure
* Evaluate build vs buy options and advise on architecture and deployment models (cloud, hybrid, on\-prem)
* Assess full solution economics including model usage, token costs, infrastructure, and run costs
* Lead and shape proofs of concept and pilots, including success criteria and evaluation frameworks
* Support development of AI governance, risk, and adoption standards
* Partner with senior stakeholders across business, technology, and finance to present options and recommendations



  





 Candidate Profile
 


* Background in transformation, PMO, consulting, or programme delivery within complex organisations
* Strong understanding of AI, automation, ML, GenAI, and enterprise architecture concepts
* Able to assess technical solutions and infrastructure trade\-offs without being a hands\-on developer
* Strong commercial mindset with experience building ROI cases and evaluating technology costs
* Comfortable operating across business and technical stakeholders at senior level
* Analytical, structured, and execution\-focused with strong problem\-solving ability



  





  





 If this role would be of interest, apply today!

data.jd_text:
**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE (Hybrid)
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Global PMO Lead
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role exists to help build and embed a fit\-for\-purpose PMO capability for the Emerging Markets (EM) business, enabling disciplined execution of innovation and portfolio priorities at pace and with quality.
   

  

 As Flora Food Group continues to scale consumer\-led innovation across regions, the Emerging Markets business requires stronger orchestration across Marketing, R\&D, Supply Chain, Finance and Operations. The PMO Manager will act as a foundational builder of this capability: setting up robust ways of working, driving executional discipline, and ensuring projects land on time, in full, and with clear accountability.
   

  

 This role is critical to reducing execution risk, improving speed\-to\-market, and freeing up functional leaders to focus on content and decision\-making rather than coordination.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Operating at the intersection of strategy and execution, you will help establish an Emerging Markets PMO operating/ framework model aligned to global P\&P / PMO standards, while tailored to local business realities.
   

  

 You will bring consistency, transparency and rigor to how innovation and portfolio initiatives are planned, governed and delivered, and act as the single point of truth for execution status, risks and delivery confidence across the EM innovation and portfolio agenda.
   

  

 You will act as the executional backbone for end\-to\-end project \& activity management, by owning the planning and orchestration of priority innovation and portfolio initiatives, ensuring cross\-functional teams’ ownership and accountability to deliver against clear timelines, milestones and decision gates.
   

  

 You will improve delivery confidence, resource visibility and decision quality across the EM portfolio by ensuring high\-quality data, discipline and follow\-through in portfolio \& project management systems. You will act as a role model for execution discipline, pragmatic problem\-solving and collaborative leadership; and you will help to build the EM PMO capability over time, including a small team, templates/tools, playbooks and best practices, as the EM hub scales.
   

  

**What This Role Is (and Is Not)**
 You will be
 **accountable for execution and orchestration** 
 , not for project content ownership. Project leadership and strategic direction will remain with the Marketing / Business leads; this role ensures the work lands.
   

  

 You are biased toward action, clarity and simplification — not to add bureaucracy.
   

  

**What Does It Take To Be Successful**
 You combine strong project management fundamentals with the confidence to operate in complex, cross\-functional FMCG environments. You are comfortable building structure where it does not yet exist, and you bring calm, clarity and momentum to ambiguous situations.
   

  

* 5–10\+ years’ experience in project, program or PMO roles within FMCG / CPG or similarly complex environments
* Experience acting as owner of PMO data quality, reporting cadence and execution dashboards in enterprise environments
* Strong systems thinker with the ability to design simple, scalable ways of working, with proven experience setting up or scaling PMO / project management structures
* Hands\-on experience managing end\-to\-end innovation, transformation or portfolio initiatives.
* Strong understanding of stage\-gate models, innovation lifecycles and launch readiness
* Confident facilitator and communicator with experience in influencing senior and cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority
* Excellent planning, prioritization, execution discipline, high accountability mindset comfortable holding others to commitments and follow\-through for continuous improvement
* Values transparency, pragmatic, solution\-oriented, resilient under pressure and energised by building capability and enabling others to succeed
* Preferred, but not required: PMP, PRINCE2, Agile / SAFe certification.


**What’s next?**
**Flora Food Group** 
 is committed to culinary essentials for better food. We believe fewer, better ideas — executed with excellence — are what drive sustainable growth.
   

  

 This is a career\-defining opportunity to work with our high\-impact brands in a high\-energy, high\-accountability environment. If you recognise yourself in this profile, apply and be part of this exciting journey. Apply now at www.florafoodgroup.com.We prefer to receive your application before
 **25th June 2026** 
 .
   

  

 We understand your resume might not be up to date and recommend that you apply with what you have or your LinkedIn Profile. Flora Food Group is dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workplace, we understand that you might not meet all the requirements stated in the description, but we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this role or other roles.
   

  

*Flora Food Group is an employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and equal opportunities for all. We recruit based only on values, qualifications, performance, skills, behaviours, experience, and knowledge. We ensure job advertisements are free from unintentional bias.*
*No personal characteristics should be a barrier to joining Flora Food Group. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other personal characteristics.*

**A Career with Trivandi**
 Working for Trivandi means the opportunity to work on the world’s most iconic projects in a supportive, people\-first environment with colleagues who are passionate, collaborative and love what they do.
   

  

 Our culture is grounded in trust and fulfilment, with a shared passion for achieving excellence, whilst having fun. We’re dedicated to ensuring that every team member’s voice is heard and valued, enabling Trivandi to be shaped and grown by the people within it.
   

  

 Ultimately, Trivandi is a place where you’ll be excited to come to work at the start of each week.
   

  

 Together, we keep our shared values at the heart of everything we do:

 We are trusted to consistently deliver to the highest international standards and professional ethics.
   

  

**OneTeam**

 : We don't stand still. We strive to make each project better than the last, daring to challenge what's gone before, in our quest for innovation and improvement.
   

  

**About Trivandi**
 Trivandi provides advisory, design and delivery services across sport, events, live entertainment and venues.
   

  

 Founded in 2013 from the success of the London 2012 Games, we have grown to over 100 specialists across four global offices in London, Dubai, Riyadh and Brisbane, delivering over 300 projects in 29 countries.
   

  

 Our unique “One Team” approach brings together the right expertise at the right time, synchronising strategy, design, project management, and operations to simplify complexity and deliver actionable solutions that drive meaningful impact.
   

  

 We passionately share our knowledge to empower local teams, unlocking the full potential of each unique experience to inspire positive change and create lasting legacies.
   

  

 That’s what we mean by creating experiences, better.
   

  

  

**About the Role**
 We are looking for a motivated People Administrator \& PRO to join our People team to support the day\-to\-day People operations and government relations activities for the business in Dubai and KSA, with a strong focus on DMCC processes and compliance.
   

  

 The role is responsible for coordinating employee lifecycle administration, including visa and immigration activities, maintaining employee records, supporting payroll inputs, and acting as the key liaison with DMCC and relevant UAE government authorities.
   

  

 This role requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and a proactive approach to employee support and compliance management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be highly energetic, professional and able to demonstrate integrity and discretion in all tasks. As this role involves handling sensitive personal and company data, you must be able to manage confidential information with the highest level of care and responsibility.
   

  

 To come on this journey with us, you’ll bring a great sense of humour, a positive and collaborative mindset, and the confidence to navigate a fast\-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment. You should be naturally resourceful, solutions\-driven, and comfortable taking initiative. Most importantly, you’ll enjoy a challenge and be excited by the opportunity to support and elevate the People function across all regions as we continue to grow.
   

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 At Trivandi all our roles are broad and flexible, but here’s a flavour of where you’ll focus your time:
   

  

**HR Administration** 
* Support day\-to\-day People administration activities across the employee lifecycle including onboarding, employment changes and offboarding.
* Prepare letters, certificates and other HR documentation.
* Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases ensuring all information is up to date and compliant.
* Coordinate onboarding processes for new employees including document collection, inductions and system access requests.
* Track probation periods, visa expiry dates, passport renewals and other key employee milestones.
* Support payroll administration by preparing monthly payroll inputs including leave, allowances, deductions and employee changes.
* Maintain annual leave and attendance records.
* Respond to employee queries relating to HR policies, benefits, visas and company procedures.
* Support the implementation and continuous improvement of HR processes and systems.
* Assist with recruitment coordination including interview scheduling, candidate communication and onboarding administration.
* Ensure all HR practices are compliant with UAE labour law and company policies.


**PRO \& Government Relations Responsibilities** 
* Act as the main point of contact for DMCC and relevant UAE government authorities.
* Manage and process employment visas, labour cards, Emirates IDs, medicals and residency permits.
* Coordinate visa applications, renewals, cancellations and status changes for employees
* Maintain accurate tracking of all visa and immigration activities and ensure renewals are completed in advance of expiry dates.
* Ensure compliance with all DMCC regulations and UAE immigration requirements.
* Coordinate document attestation and notarisation processes where required.
* Support WPS and labour\-related administrative requirements.
* Keep up to date with changes to UAE labour law, immigration regulations and DMCC requirements and communicate impacts to the business.
* Support the KSA People team with KSA Business Visa applications and renewals, monitoring expiry dates and turnaround times. Ensure all documentation is complete and correct before employees visit the visa processing centre.


**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Personal Skills and Experience**
 The key knowledge, experience, and qualifications we are looking for include:
 * 1–2 years of experience in Human Resources or People operations in Dubai, ideally within a professional services or fast\-paced environment.
* Strong administration skills developed within a professional setting.
* Experience with HRMS platforms or other relevant HR information system.
* Proficient in the use of IT and Microsoft programmes and iOS applications.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Desirable \- DMCC systems knowledge
* Desirable – KSA business visa and Iqama knowledge
* Strongly desirable \- Arabic speaker


**About You**
 The key competencies and behaviours we are looking for include:
 * Excellent team working skills with an open, friendly, and supportive style.
* Ability to effectively, accurately, and concisely present and communicate in both written and verbal forms and be empathetic across different audiences and cultural sensitivities.
* Proven attention to detail
* Able to handle shifting demands.
* Responsive and helpful
* Self\-motivated and resourceful
* Loyal, displaying the highest levels of integrity and commitment.
* Flexible and adaptable in a dynamic company


**Benefits**
 If you are successful in this application we will invest in you, support, and train you to be successful, opening up a world of opportunities.
   

  

 Trivandi is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity amongst our team. We aim to be truly representative of all sections of society, creating an environment where everyone feels respected and able to give of their best. We therefore warmly welcome applications from anyone who meets the criteria we’ve described.

**Job Description**
 We exist to create positive change for people and the planet. Join us and make a difference too!
   

  

****Overview / Purpose Of The Position****
 The internal and supplier assurance (ISA) business partners with clients to build trust within their organisations and across their value chains. ISA has undergone tremendous growth, and this strategic role will support this growth across the EMEA region by shaping our approach to delivering client solutions, enabling us to add greater value to our clients and enhance our client centricity, whilst harmonising with global and other regional efforts.
   

  

 The Head of Operations will build the EMEA operational framework for this business line, integrating it seamlessly into the company's established processes while ensuring it operates with commercial discipline, efficiency, and scalability, all whilst ensuring alignment with the global ISA community to drive standardisation.
   

  

 This role requires a leader who can create a tightly integrated delivery engine that ensures quality, efficiency, margin control, and regulatory readiness, without duplicating the company’s infrastructure. The successful candidate will combine strong operational leadership with a solid understanding of professional services, preferably within audit or advisory environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Accountabilities**
* Process: This role will collaborate with relevant stakeholders to define the client journey for ISA throughout EMEA whilst working closely with global teams to ensure alignment.


**This Will Result In a Process That:**
* Is clearer, better understood, and aligned and embedded across the globe.
* Is more efficient and effective in servicing both EMEA and global client contracts.
* Is considerate and aligned to the future direction and growth of the ISA business.
* incorporates governance and transparency at its core.
* Effectively leverages existing best practices
* Operational delivery: This role will be responsible for working with direct reports and other regional leaders to mobilise our teams to deploy a client\-centric solution across our clients. They will maintain within the region the competencies and roles required to support the operational delivery of the ISA programs, and collaborate with the respective regions to develop these competencies more widely to support EMEA programs.


**This Will Result In:**
* A clear framework of the competencies required when delivering an ISA program.
* Greater understanding of and alignment with the competencies adopted across the regions.
* Increased capacity and capability to support the ISA programs.
* Improved program performance and impact on the client organisation
* The sales teams feel more supported when engaging with or building client proposals, and confident in our ability and expertise to deliver the solution.
* Global Hub: This role will be responsible for aligning EMEA operations with the global Hub


 This will result in greater clarity in the roles and responsibilities of the hub
   

  

* Governance: This role will work collaboratively with the respective compliance teams to ensure ISA controls and processes are appropriate, proportionate to the risk, embedded and effective.


**This Will Result In:**
* Risk mitigation to a reasonable level
* The forming and maintaining of strong external relationships with internal compliance teams
* The forming and maintaining of strong external relationships with associations and regulators, keeping abreast of changes, and ensuring they are translated into our ways of working
* Performance:
* This role will be responsible for delivering ISA revenue and growth across EMEA, whilst working with the global team to drive global growth and revenue. This will result in
* Deeper understanding of ISA performance at a client and program level
* An established cadence of performance monitoring
* Greater focus and emphasis on improving business performance.
* More insights to feed into business forecast and strategic resource planning.

**Designation: Director, Strategy \& Transformation / Director CEO Office \& Transformation** 




**Location: Dubai, UAE** 




  





**About SUMWON STUDIOS** 




**SUMWON STUDIOS** 
 is a global brand house building, scaling and reimagining culturally relevant fashion, lifestyle and consumer brands. Our portfolio includes
 **MISSGUIDED, SUMWON, BALR, Baby Phat, Playboy, AiiRZ, KiZN** 
 and
 **KSTM.** 




  





 In just a few years, we have grown from start\-up to one of the fastest\-scaling brand platforms in the
 
 industry. Combining creativity, data, technology and an agile supply chain, we build brands designed to win in today's digital\-first world.
 



  





 We operate at the intersection of culture, commerce and innovation. Whether launching new brands, acquiring established ones, or unlocking growth opportunities across our portfolio, we move quickly, think globally and challenge conventional ways of working.
 



  





**The Role** 




 This is not a traditional Chief of Staff role.
 



  





 The primary purpose of this position is to act as a force multiplier for the CEO and leadership team, increasing the speed, quality and effectiveness of decision making and execution across the organisation.
 



  





 You will work across every function of the business, helping shape strategy while ensuring critical initiatives are delivered. You will lead transformation programmes, drive organisational effectiveness, champion AI and automation adoption, and take ownership of high\-impact strategic projects.
 



 The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking with relentless execution. We are less interested in career consultants and more interested in operators who have helped build, scale and transform businesses from the inside.
 



  





 This role is designed for someone with the ambition and capability to become a future GM, COO or CEO.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 CEO Office \& Strategic Execution
 


* Partner directly with the CEO on the company's most important priorities.
* Translate strategy into clear action plans, accountability and measurable outcomes.
* Drive execution of strategic initiatives across all functions.
* Monitor business performance and identify opportunities, risks and bottlenecks.
* Act as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the CEO.
* Independently lead major initiatives with minimal direction.



 AI, Technology \& Business Transformation
 


* Lead the identification, prioritisation and implementation of AI, automation and technology initiatives across the business.
* Partner with functional leaders to redesign processes and operating models using technology.
* Drive measurable improvements in productivity, speed, quality and cost efficiency.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to create competitive advantage.
* Establish a culture of innovation, experimentation and continuous improvement.



 Organisational Effectiveness
 


* Drive company\-wide OKRs, governance and accountability frameworks.
* Improve decision\-making processes and organisational operating rhythms.
* Help ensure the business scales effectively as teams, brands and markets grow.
* Support leadership teams in defining structures, responsibilities and ways of working.
* Remove complexity and improve cross\-functional collaboration.



 Strategic Projects \& Corporate Development
 


* Lead high\-priority projects on behalf of the CEO.
* Support acquisitions, partnerships, market expansion and new business initiatives.
* Coordinate due diligence, integration planning and execution activities.
* Develop business cases, strategic recommendations and implementation plans.



 Internal \& Corporate Communications
 


* Support company\-wide communication of strategic priorities and transformation programmes.
* Help align teams around business objectives and organisational change.
* Support investor, board, media and external stakeholder communications where required.
* Prepare executive presentations, board materials and strategic updates.



 Talent \& Leadership Support
 


* Support organisational and leadership development initiatives.
* Help identify capability gaps and opportunities to strengthen the organisation.
* Work alongside senior leaders to improve team effectiveness and performance.
* Contribute to succession planning and future leadership development.



  





**What you’ll bring** 



* 5\+ years of experience in strategy, consulting, private equity, venture capital, technology, e\-commerce, consumer or high\-growth businesses.
* Strong preference for candidates who have experience both advising businesses and operating within them.
* Demonstrated success leading complex cross\-functional initiatives.
* Exceptional problem\-solving and analytical capabilities.
* Strong commercial judgement and business acumen.
* Experience driving transformation, technology or AI initiatives is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment.
* Comfortable operating in fast\-moving, entrepreneurial environments.
* Highly organised with exceptional execution capabilities.



  





**What we'll bring** 



* 25 days annual leave, increasing to 30 days after your first year
* 30% employee discount across SUMWON STUDIOS brands
* Ongoing learning and development opportunities
* Company social events
* The opportunity to work with a high\-performing team building brands at global scale



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 This is an opportunity to join a business in growth mode. You'll have the chance to make a visible impact, take ownership, move quickly and help shape the future of a multi\-brand platform operating across global markets.

data.jd_text:
**Role Description** 




 The Regional Director – Middle East \& French West Africa will lead the establishment, expansion, and long‑term development of the company’s pharmaceutical business across the Middle East Region and Francophone West Africa. The role carries full regional P\&L responsibility and is accountable for building a scalable commercial platform capable of delivering sustainable growth across multiple markets.
 



  





 The regional expansion strategy will initially focus on establishing a strong presence in Iraq, Senegal, and Ivory Coast, followed by expansion into selected non\-GCC Middle Eastern markets and key Frontier and West African (FWA) markets. Subsequently, the strategy will extend to GCC countries to further strengthen the company's regional footprint.
 



  





 This position represents a senior regional leadership role responsible for developing the company’s commercial footprint, building high‑performing country teams, establishing strong distributor and stakeholder relationships and delivering consistent financial and operational performance across the region.
 



  





 The successful candidate will combine strong strategic leadership with hands‑on execution capability and an entrepreneurial mindset suited to building a regional business in the region.
 



  





**Governance and Reporting Structure** 




 The Regional Director will report to the Group Director International Business and will be responsible for overall governance, operational leadership, and financial performance of the defined region.
 



 Key governance responsibilities include:
 


* Full regional profit and loss accountability
* Development and execution of regional business plans
* Establishment of effective governance and reporting processes
* Alignment of regional strategy with global corporate objectives
* Ensuring regulatory, financial, and operational compliance across all markets



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Regional Strategy Development** 



* Develop and implement the commercial strategy for the region.
* Identify and prioritize new market entry opportunities including new countries, therapeutic segments, market segments, and product opportunities.
* Develop multi‑year regional growth plans including revenue targets, portfolio expansion, and market penetration strategies.
* Assess regulatory environments and competitive landscapes across the region.



  





**Market Entry and Expansion** 



* Lead the planning and execution of country launches across priority markets.
* Establish commercial operations in new markets including distributor and promotional agency partnerships, commercial infrastructure, and local teams.
* Expand operations beyond the initial markets of Iraq, Senegal and Ivory Coast, into other regional markets.
* Drive early market entry and rapid product launch strategies.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic leadership**
* Develop and execute the oncology and hematology business strategy across Gulf markets, aligned with global and regional priorities.
* Identify growth opportunities across the portfolio, including lifecycle management and new indications.
* Lead long\-range planning, forecasting and portfolio prioritization.


**P\&L ownership**
* Own and manage full profit and loss responsibility for the oncology business.
* Deliver revenue, profitability and market share targets across the region.
* Optimize resource allocation to maximize return on investment and ensure financial discipline.


**Sales and marketing leadership**
* Lead and integrate sales and marketing functions to drive execution excellence across diverse Gulf healthcare systems.
* Oversee brand strategy, campaign development and omnichannel customer engagement.
* Ensure strong field force effectiveness and customer\-centric engagement with healthcare professionals.


**Product launch excellence**
* Lead end\-to\-end launch planning and execution for new oncology and hematology assets in Gulf markets.
* Partner with global and regional teams to ensure successful localization of launch strategies.

**Cross\-functional collaboration**

* Ensure alignment across functions to deliver compliant and impactful business outcomes.
* Engage appropriate external stakeholders, such as healthcare institutions and relevant decision\-makers across the Gulf region, in line with GSK policies and local regulations.


**Team leadership and capability building**
* Build, lead and inspire a high\-performing, diverse team across multiple Gulf markets.
* Develop organizational capabilities in sales, marketing and leadership.
* Foster a culture of accountability, inclusion, innovation and continuous improvement, aligned with GSK’s values and Code of Conduct.


**Key Qualifications And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree required; an advanced degree in a scientific or business discipline is strongly preferred.
* Extensive experience in oncology and/or hematology with a strong track record in these therapeutic areas.
* Deep scientific understanding of oncology, including disease biology, treatment paradigms and evolving clinical data.
* Proven ability to translate complex scientific insights into effective commercial strategies.
* Significant senior leadership experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology commercial roles (sales and marketing).
* Demonstrated P\&L management experience with consistent delivery of business results.
* Strong track record of successful product launches and lifecycle management in oncology.
* Experience in Gulf markets is highly preferred, with strong understanding of local healthcare systems, market access dynamics and regulatory environments.

**Leadership Capabilities**
* Strategic thinker with strong business and scientific acumen.

* High ethical standards, integrity and a strong commitment to compliance and patient focus.

**Why GSK?
   

  

 Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
   

  

 People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

* About Arada


 Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Sharjah, UAE, Arada was created to build spaces that inspire, connect, and enrich communities. As one of the region’s fastest\-growing master developers, Arada has delivered landmark residential, retail, hospitality, and lifestyle destinations that redefine modern living.
   

  

 At Arada, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and high\-performance culture where talented professionals are empowered to make a meaningful impact on the communities we create.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Act as the central operational link and technical attaché to the Project Controls Director, driving portfolio\-wide data consolidation, cross\-functional stakeholder coordination, and executive reporting from the Head Office. This role is responsible for standardizing reporting frameworks across all high\-rise and master development sites, monitoring design and procurement trackers, and developing C\-suite presentations, serving as the strategic right\-hand support for all departmental operations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Portfolio Data Consolidation \& Reporting Governance
* Central Database Management: Establish and maintain the department's central project controls database, ensuring seamless data harvesting and consolidation from all project sites.
* Reporting Standardization: Design, implement, and enforce standardized weekly and monthly reporting templates across contractors, consultants, and internal project teams to ensure consistency, accuracy, and transparency.
* Periodic Audit \& Review: Conduct rigorous reviews of incoming site reports, cross\-verifying contractor progress claims against actual site conditions and flagging critical path anomalies, schedule risks, and reporting inconsistencies directly to the Project Controls Director.
* Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Coordination (Pre\-Contract Tracks)
* Design \& Procurement Tracking: Establish, manage, and continuously update comprehensive trackers and dashboards for pre\-construction activities, with a strong focus on design development, authority approvals, procurement milestones, and package award schedules.
* Internal Stakeholder Interface: Coordinate directly with Development Managers, Design Directors, and Procurement leads to resolve scheduling conflicts and ensure pre\-contract deliverables align with planned construction commencement dates.
* Master Program Development: Support the Project Controls Director in developing, maintaining, and logic\-linking portfolio\-level master programs that integrate design, permitting, tendering, procurement, and construction activities.
* Executive Analytics \& C\-Suite Presentations
* Dashboard Management: Maintain and oversee the department’s live Power BI and ERP\-based dashboards, transforming complex project, commercial, and schedule data into meaningful performance indicators and executive\-level insights.
* Executive Presentation Development: Consolidate portfolio\-wide progress updates, schedule risks, delay exposures, and cost\-related insights into professional, structured presentations and briefing materials for the CDO, CFO, CEO, and Executive Leadership Team.
* Special Briefings \& Ad\-Hoc Analytics: Act as an operational extension of the Project Controls Director by conducting deep\-dive analyses, forensic schedule reviews, and focused data audits on critical or distressed project packages as required.
* Site\-HO Bridging \& Compliance Enforcement
* Site Coordination: Maintain close engagement with embedded site planning teams, consultants, and contractors to ensure real\-time visibility of progress, risks, and emerging critical path delays.
* Process Enforcement: Audit planning and reporting compliance across all projects, ensuring schedule networks, baseline updates, milestone reporting, and delay notifications adhere strictly to Arada’s Project Controls Manual and governance requirements.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* PMP or PMI\-SP (Scheduling Professional) certifications are highly advantageous.


**Experience**
* 7–10 years of progressive project planning and scheduling experience within the UAE real estate, developer, or construction sector.
* A balanced background is essential, including:
+ Minimum 3–4 years of hands\-on site\-based construction planning and execution experience.
+ Minimum 3–4 years within a Head Office PMO, Project Controls, or Developer corporate environment.

* Proven experience supporting multiple projects simultaneously and coordinating across diverse stakeholder groups.


**Technical Skills**
* Advanced to expert\-level proficiency in Primavera P6\.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel reporting and analytical capabilities.
* Strong Power BI dashboard development and data visualization skills.
* Advanced PowerPoint presentation design with the ability to prepare executive\-level reporting materials.
* Strong understanding of project controls methodologies, schedule governance, and portfolio reporting frameworks.


**Core Competency**
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organizational agility.
* Ability to confidently engage with senior leadership while maintaining strong technical credibility with consultants, contractors, and project teams.
* Strong analytical mindset with the capability to challenge assumptions, identify reporting inconsistencies, and provide data\-driven recommendations.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and capable of operating effectively in a fast\-paced, multi\-project environment.

**Head of Transformation (Project Lifecycle Management)** 




  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced Head of Transformation to lead a large\-scale enterprise transformation programme across a complex project and real estate portfolio. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving end\-to\-end business transformation across project delivery, commercial operations, governance, financial management, handover, and operational readiness.
 



  





 The successful candidate will own the transformation vision, business case, value realisation, and adoption strategy, ensuring measurable business outcomes through the implementation of standardised processes, governance frameworks, and technology\-enabled ways of working.
 



 This role is focused on transforming how projects are delivered and managed across the organisation—not simply implementing systems or managing programme governance.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Define and lead the transformation vision, strategy, and business case across the project lifecycle.
* Drive measurable business outcomes including improved governance, compliance, cost control, schedule performance, transparency, and operational efficiency.
* Lead the design and implementation of future\-state operating models and standardised ways of working.
* Champion organisational change and user adoption across multiple business functions and stakeholder groups.
* Partner with executive leadership to secure alignment, influence decision\-making, and resolve cross\-functional challenges.
* Develop and manage a multi\-year transformation roadmap, balancing business priorities, value delivery, and organisational readiness.
* Oversee delivery through programme, platform, integration, and change management teams.
* Ensure successful coordination between business and technology functions, including enterprise platforms and integrated systems.
* Build and lead high\-performing transformation, product, and change teams capable of sustaining long\-term organisational capability.
* Manage external partners and vendors to ensure delivery against agreed timelines, budgets, and business outcomes.



  





**Required Experience** 



* 12–18\+ years of experience leading large\-scale enterprise transformation programmes.
* Proven track record delivering measurable business value through organisational transformation and change initiatives.
* Experience leading multi\-year, cross\-functional transformation programmes at enterprise scale.
* Strong change management and adoption leadership, with demonstrated success driving behavioural and process change.
* Ability to influence C\-suite stakeholders and navigate complex organisational environments.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience balancing priorities, risks, and business outcomes.
* Experience in at least one of the following: real estate, construction, infrastructure, or capital project environments
* Project lifecycle management and capital delivery processes
* Enterprise project management or project controls platforms (e.g., Primavera Unifier, Primavera P6, or similar solutions)
* Understanding of governance, controls, delegation of authority frameworks, audit requirements, and integrated ERP environments.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly understand new business domains and technologies.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree is mandatory.
* Experience within the GCC region, particularly the UAE.
* Exposure to real estate development, infrastructure, or large capital project portfolios.
* Knowledge of Oracle Primavera Unifier, Primavera P6, or equivalent project lifecycle management platforms.
* Professional certifications such as PMP, MSP, PRINCE2, or Prosci Change Management.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 This opportunity is ideal for a transformation leader who has successfully led enterprise\-wide change programmes and thrives in complex, fast\-paced environments. We are looking for someone who combines strategic vision with hands\-on execution, can influence senior stakeholders, and has a passion for driving sustainable organisational transformation and value creation.

CNS (Computer Network Systems) is a technology company in the middle\-east \& has over 30 years of successful achievements and long\-term partnerships with distinct customers across the region.
   

  

 We are an IT distributor \& our expertise are in Banking \& Financial Service Insurance, Technology Enablement, IT Outsourcing, Cyber security, Digital Infrastructure, Hybrid Cloud, Digital Workplace, Customer Experience, Digital Transformation, and Block Chain.
   

  

 We are a Part of the Ghobash Group of Companies, CNS spread across the region with offices in Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Oman, and Kuwait providing a holistic approach that covers all aspects of information communication technology system integration, consultancy, operation, managed services, and IT outsourcing.
   

  

 CNS also has state\-of\-the\-art network operation centers in Abu Dhabi and Dubai that develop in\-house software and applications providing end\-to\-end solutions to our customers and partners.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Project Manager is responsible for managing the successful delivery of technology and systems integration projects across the project lifecycle, ensuring alignment with approved scope, schedule, budget, quality standards, and customer expectations.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of PMO, the Project Manager will work closely with Senior Project Managers, technical teams, vendors, and client stakeholders to coordinate project execution activities, monitor delivery progress, manage operational risks, and maintain project governance documentation.
   

  

 The role requires strong coordination, communication, and organizational skills to manage day\-to\-day delivery activities across multiple concurrent projects while supporting governance and reporting requirements defined by the PMO.
   

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities**
**Project Delivery \& Coordination**
* Manage the day\-to\-day execution of assigned technology and systems integration projects.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, task trackers, action logs, RAID logs, dependency trackers, and change request records.
* Monitor project progress against approved baselines and escalate deviations, risks, and delays in a timely manner.
* Coordinate project activities across technical teams, vendors, subcontractors, procurement, and client stakeholders.
* Track project deliverables, milestones, approvals, and operational dependencies to ensure timely execution.
* Support project planning activities including resource coordination, effort tracking, and timeline management.
* Coordinate UAT activities, deployment readiness, transition to support, and project closure activities.


**Stakeholder \& Client Management**
* Maintain effective communication with project stakeholders, technical teams, and client representatives.
* Participate in project governance meetings, progress reviews, operational discussions, and status reporting sessions.
* Ensure project actions, decisions, risks, and dependencies are properly documented and communicated.
* Support the management of client expectations through transparent reporting and proactive coordination.
* Escalate project issues and operational blockers to senior management and PMO leadership when required.


**Vendor \& Delivery Management**

* Monitor vendor deliverables and support tracking of contractual milestones and acceptance activities.
* Follow up on pending actions, technical dependencies, and issue resolution activities with delivery partners.
* Assist in coordinating change requests, variation discussions, and delivery impact assessments.


**Governance \& Reporting**

+ Project plans
+ RAID logs
+ Status reports
+ Change logs
+ Action trackers
+ Meeting minutes

* Prepare weekly and monthly project status reports for PMO and management review.
* Support PMO governance processes, reporting standards, and compliance requirements.
* Ensure project documentation is centrally maintained and aligned with PMO standards.


**PMO \& Process Support**
* Support PMO initiatives related to process standardization, governance improvements, and reporting optimization.
* Contribute to the adoption of project management tools, reporting templates, and PMO best practices.
* Assist in maintaining project data quality and portfolio reporting accuracy within PMO systems and reporting platforms.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to project delivery and operational efficiency.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
**Minimum:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related discipline.


**Desired:**
* PMP certification or equivalent project management certification.
* Agile, PRINCE2, or Scrum certifications are an advantage.


**Experience**
**Minimum:**
* 5\+ years of project management or project coordination experience within technology or systems integration environments.
* Experience managing client\-facing technology projects and coordinating cross\-functional teams.
* Experience maintaining project schedules, RAID logs, and governance reporting.
* Exposure to vendor coordination and multi\-stakeholder project environments.


**Desired:**
* Experience within UAE/GCC government or enterprise environments.
* Experience working within a PMO governance structure.
* Familiarity with project portfolio management and reporting tools.
* Experience supporting systems integration, infrastructure, software, or digital transformation projects.


**Skills \& Abilities**
**Minimum:**
* Good understanding of project management methodologies including Waterfall and Agile delivery approaches.
* Strong coordination and organizational skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and concurrent project activities.
* Strong follow\-up, documentation, and reporting capability.
* Good stakeholder communication and escalation management skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively across technical and business teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Project, Excel, PowerPoint, and project reporting tools.


**Desired:**
* Proficiency in EPMO/PPM tooling platforms and ability to drive adoption across teams.
* Experience developing PMO dashboards, KPI frameworks, and portfolio reporting.
* Strong understanding of commercial and contractual terms in systems integration engagements.
* Experience managing stakeholders at C\-suite and board level.
* Change management and organizational transformation experience.


**Additional Information**

**Why qlub**
 The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.
   

  

 From Pay\-at\-Table and Digital Menus to Order\-and\-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.
   

  

 We're a fast\-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e\& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.
   

  

**The role**
 qlub is scaling fast across markets worldwide, and we look for people who take real ownership of their work. As our next Operations Executive, you'll help drive our growth in Partner Success building, shipping, and delivering results from day one.
   

  

 You'll work closely with operators and partners to turn frictionless payments into real growth for restaurants. You'll also play a key role in ensuring new restaurant partners have a smooth onboarding journey and that existing partners maximize their adoption of Qlub solutions. From training restaurant staff to troubleshooting issues and driving re\-engagement, you'll be at the frontlines of ensuring our partners and their customers have the best possible experience.
   

  

 If you thrive in a fast\-moving, build\-from\-scratch environment, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**Onboarding \& Setup**
* Support the full onboarding journey of new restaurant partners, including account setup and system configurations when required

On behalf of our client, a fast\-growing Gaming company, we are seeking dynamic
 **MCN Operation Manager** 
 for their studio in Dubai.
 



  





 You will take full responsibility for the daily operational management, team coordination, and goal execution across the company's business divisions (TikTok live streaming, MCN, and e\-commerce). With a focus on the synergistic advantages of "traffic reuse, resource sharing, and data interoperability," you will optimize operational processes, enhance operational efficiency, ensure the smooth achievement of the company's annual business objectives and performance targets, and drive the efficient operation of the company's full\-ecosystem business.
 











 You will directly manage core business teams including live streaming operations, MCN, content, and e\-commerce, while collaborating with support departments such as technology, administration, and HR to close the business loop and improve synergy and monetization capabilities across all divisions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***Overall Business Operations Coordination***



* Oversee the daily operations of all business segments, including TikTok live streaming (group livestreams \+ individual livestreams) and MCN talent incubation; formulate operational strategies and execution plans for each segment to ensure orderly progress.
* Focus on core business metrics by breaking down goals, assigning tasks, tracking execution progress, and promptly adjusting operational strategies to ensure targets are met.



  





***Team Management and Capability Enhancement***



* Manage core business teams such as live streaming operations, MCN, and content; clarify team responsibilities and assessment standards; select, train, and motivate team members to improve their professional capabilities and execution.
* Build an efficient operational management system, optimize operational processes, promote cross\-departmental collaboration (e.g., live streaming with e\-commerce, content with MCN, culture/tourism with content), and resolve cross\-departmental coordination issues during operations.


- 


***Operational Optimization and Innovation***



* Monitor operational data across all business segments, analyze underlying issues and opportunities, propose optimization plans, and continuously improve operational efficiency and business quality (e.g., optimizing livestream workflows, talent incubation systems, and e\-commerce supply chains).
* Track local industry dynamics and competitor activities in the Middle East; leverage the company's ecosystem advantages to drive innovation in operational models, content, and engagement formats, thereby creating differentiated competitive advantages.



  





***Compliance and Resource Synergy***



* Ensure operational compliance across all business segments, strictly adhering to Dubai local laws, regulations, and religious/cultural requirements; implement measures such as three\-tier review for e\-commerce products and livestream compliance to mitigate operational risks.
* Collaborate with the technology department to apply AI tools and other solutions in operations to reduce costs; work with the administration department to support the efficient operation of the 2,000 sqm livestreaming hub, providing a solid foundation for business activities.



  





***Reporting and Review***



* Regularly report to the CEO on the operational status, target achievement, existing issues, and solutions for each business segment; submit operational review reports and optimization suggestions.
* Organize regular review sessions with various business teams to summarize lessons, optimize processes, and drive continuous iterative improvements in operations.



  





**Requirements** 



1. Bachelor's degree or above, with 3–8\+ years of experience in operations management, including at least 2 years of local operations management experience in the Middle East (Dubai preferred), and a solid understanding of the Middle East market's operational logic and cultural characteristics.
2. Fluent in both Chinese and English
3. Proven experience in operations management within MCN, TikTok livestreaming, or related industries; experience in overall business coordination and cross\-departmental collaboration is preferred; familiarity with both group and individual livestreaming models is a bonus.
4. Excellent strategic planning, data analysis, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to respond quickly to market changes and adjust operational strategies accordingly.
5. Strong leadership, execution, and resilience under pressure; skilled in team management and motivation, with the ability to lead teams toward operational goals and demonstrate outstanding communication and coordination abilities.
6. Familiar with Dubai's local operational compliance requirements; experience with livestreaming hubs or full\-ecosystem business operations is preferred; alignment with the company's development philosophy is expected.



  





**What We Offer:** 



* Full\-time employment contract
* Relocation package (available for candidates not currently residing in Dubai)
* Company\-sponsored work visa

data.jd_text:
Role : Director\- Delivery \& Installation Operations
 



 Location: Dubai, UAE
 



  





 This role exists to industrialize delivery and installation operations by introducing scalable operational systems, process discipline, and advanced last\-mile execution methodologies into a high\-volume, concurrent project environment. The position does not replace existing technical expertise — it complements it by building the operational architecture, governance, and scalability layer the business requires for its next phase of growth.
 



  





 The organization currently operates approximately 25 active customer projects per day across varying project sizes, product categories, installation durations, site conditions, and customer expectations. The environment has transitioned from a linear model to a dynamic operational network requiring:
 



 • Concurrent multi\-site project management
 



 • Daily resource reallocation and scheduling
 



 • Continuous customer communication at scale
 



 • Real\-time operational dependency management
 



 • Structured escalation and SLA\-based execution
 



  





 The core challenge is not technical installation knowledge — the organization possesses strong field execution capability. The gap is the absence of advanced process\-driven operational leadership capable of transforming fragmented execution into a scalable, predictable, and systemized operational engine.
 



  





 1\. Operational Architecture \& Process Design
 



 • Design, document, and implement end\-to\-end operational workflows covering scheduling, dispatch, installation sequencing, and project closure
 



 • Standardize all field execution processes across crew types, project categories, and site conditions
 



 • Build and maintain operational SOPs, handover protocols, and quality checkpoints
 



 • Transition the department from reactive firefighting to a structured, repeatable execution model
 



 2\. Multi\-Project Scheduling \& Dispatch Optimization
 



 • Own the daily and weekly scheduling function for all active installation and delivery projects
 



 • Implement dispatch optimization logic to maximize crew utilization and minimize idle time
 



 • Develop priority sequencing models that account for site readiness, product availability, and customer commitments
 



 • Manage resource conflicts and reallocate teams dynamically in response to live operational changes
 



 3\. Operational Control Tower
 



 • Establish and operate a live control tower function providing real\-time visibility into all active projects
 



 • Define and monitor key operational KPIs: on\-time completion rate, revisit rate, crew utilisation, SLA adherence, and delay frequency
 



 • Build dashboards and reporting structures for daily operational review and senior management reporting
 



 • Identify operational bottlenecks early and drive structured resolution
 



 4\. Workforce Coordination \& Utilisation
 



 • Manage crew capacity planning, deployment, and productivity tracking
 



 • Coordinate with HR on workforce resourcing, shift planning, and contractor management
 



 • Develop performance frameworks for field teams aligned to operational KPIs
 



 • Reduce overdependence on key individuals by building cross\-trained, interchangeable crew structures
 



 5\. Customer Coordination \& SLA Management
 



 • Define and enforce SLA frameworks covering installation lead times, communication standards, and escalation thresholds
 



 • Work with customer\-facing teams to align operational capacity with customer commitments
 



 • Build structured customer coordination protocols for pre\-installation, day\-of, and post\-installation touchpoints
 



 • Own escalation handling for time\-sensitive or complex customer situations
 



 6\. Technology \& Systems Integration
 



 • Lead the evaluation, selection, and implementation of operational management technology (scheduling tools, field service management platforms, and dispatch systems)
 



 • Work with IT to integrate operational systems with ERP, CRM, and customer portals
 



 • Drive adoption of digital tools across field teams to improve real\-time communication and job visibility
 



 7\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
 



 • Act as the primary operational interface between the installation department, sales, logistics, procurement, and customer experience teams
 



 • Align project execution timelines with product availability, warehouse readiness, and client schedules
 



 • Participate in strategic planning discussions to translate business growth targets into operational capacity requirements
 



  





 8\. Leadership \& Culture
 



 • Build and mentor a high\-performance operational leadership team within the department
 



 • Establish a culture of accountability, process discipline, and continuous improvement
 



 • Champion data\-driven decision\-making and operational transparency across all levels of the team
 



  





 Academic Qualification :
 



 Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field
 



 Master's degree (MBA or MSc Operations/Supply Chain Management)
 



 Certification
 



 Relevant operational or project management certification (PMP, APICS CPIM, or equivalent)
 



 Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Green Belt; PRINCE2; Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP)
 



 Industry knowledge
 



 Demonstrated understanding of last\-mile logistics, field service operations, or installation project management
 



 Experience with furniture, fit\-out, modular kitchen, or home installation industries
 



 Proficiency in operational management tools, scheduling platforms, and ERP systems
 



 Experience with field service management software (e.g. ServiceMax, FieldAware, SAP FSM)
 



  





 Experience :
 



 Minimum 15 years in operations leadership, with at least 5 years at a senior management or director level
 



 Last\-mile operations
 



 Proven track record in high\-volume last\-mile delivery or installation environments (25\+ daily projects)
 



 Process transformation
 



 Demonstrated experience transitioning reactive operational models into scalable, process\-driven execution frameworks
 



 Multi\-site management
 



 Experience managing concurrent projects across multiple sites with dynamic resource allocation
 



 Team leadership
 



 Experience building and leading cross\-functional operations teams of 20 or more
 



 Technology implementation
 



 Track record of leading operational technology deployments (scheduling, FSM, ERP, or dispatch systems)

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

data.jd_text:
**About PFM**
 Prop Firm Match Global FZCO is a leading platform for discovering, comparing, and selecting top proprietary trading firms. We provide traders with tools and features to easily compare challenge details, read verified reviews, see accurate payout data, and much more. We're a fast\-moving, fully remote team with members from all around the world caring deeply about the quality of what we build. Our culture values ownership, clear communication, and practical impact over fluff. Whether you're a trader, technologist, marketer, or operator \- your work here shapes how thousands of users find and trust prop firms.
   

  

**About The Department**
 UAE Operations \& Regulatory Affairs sits at the intersection of Finance, Legal, and Operations. It owns the integrity of PFM's UAE\-based entity (Prop Firm Match Global FZCO) — governance, free\-zone compliance, banking, tax, audit, visa sponsorship, and regulator\-facing relationships. Our current priority is professionalising the local operating layer so the business can scale internationally without regulatory or operational drag.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Own everything PFM does in the UAE — entity governance, regulatory standing, banking and tax compliance, audit readiness, free\-zone licensing, visa sponsorship, and relationships with local authorities and service providers. Be the senior PFM presence on the ground in the UAE and the trusted commercial\-regulatory bridge between leadership and the UAE ecosystem.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Performance objectives**
**Objective 1 \- Own UAE entity governance and free\-zone compliance**
 Outcome: Prop Firm Match Global FZCO is fully compliant, in good standing, and audit\-ready at all times.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Maintain free\-zone licence, share capital, and corporate documentation up to date
* Ensure timely renewals, statutory filings, and entity\-level reporting
* Coordinate with the free\-zone authority on all governance matters
* Run quarterly governance reviews with the CFO


**Objective 2 \- Lead regulatory affairs and authority relationships**
 Outcome: PFM operates with regulatory clarity in the UAE and can navigate questions from authorities quickly and credibly.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Own the regulatory map for PFM's activities in the UAE (free\-zone, federal, financial\-services adjacencies)
* Build and maintain relationships with regulators, free\-zone authorities, banks, and key service providers
* Track regulatory changes affecting PFM and translate them into business impact and action items
* Lead any direct regulator engagement or audit on PFM's behalf, in coordination with legal counsel
* Partner with internal and external legal counsel on the UAE legal landscape — contracts, employment law, FZCO governance, commercial agreements, and dispute resolution


**Objective 3 \- Manage UAE operations: banking, tax, audit, and admin**
 Outcome: All UAE\-side operational rails (banking, corporate tax, VAT, audit, visas, office, vendors) run smoothly with no surprises.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Manage banking relationships and resolve account\-, transaction\-, or compliance\-related issues
* Oversee UAE corporate tax (9%) and VAT registration, filings, and compliance with the Federal Tax Authority
* Lead the annual statutory audit cycle in coordination with the Finance function
* Sponsor visas for UAE\-based hires and manage related immigration, residency, and renewal workflows
* Own the UAE office presence (if applicable), vendor contracts, insurance, and local administration


**Objective 4 \- Partner with leadership on UAE strategic initiatives**
 Outcome: Leadership has a trusted UAE partner who can scope, scale, and de\-risk any new initiative anchored in the region.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Advise leadership on the regulatory and operational implications of new products, partnerships, or markets
* Lead UAE\-specific initiatives such as banking expansion, new entity structures, or regulatory licensing
* Represent PFM in select UAE industry forums and at high\-trust meetings with partners or authorities
* Surface risks and opportunities to the CFO and CEO with clear written analysis


**What We Look For**
**Must have**
* 7\+ years of operations, regulatory, or compliance leadership experience in the UAE
* Hands\-on familiarity with one or more UAE free zones (e.g., DMCC, IFZA, DIFC, ADGM, JAFZA)
* Strong working knowledge of UAE corporate tax, VAT, and Federal Tax Authority requirements
* Experience managing banking relationships and resolving compliance / KYC matters with UAE banks
* Track record of running statutory audits and filings end\-to\-end
* Demonstrated experience working with internal or external legal counsel on UAE\-specific matters — contracts, employment law, free\-zone governance, or commercial agreements
* Excellent English; comfortable operating in a remote\-first, async\-first environment


**Nice to have**
* Background in fintech, financial services, brokerage, or trading\-adjacent industries
* DIFC or ADGM\-specific licensing experience
* Working Arabic — useful for direct regulator and bank conversations
* Existing relationships with UAE regulators, free\-zone authorities, or top legal / audit firms
* Experience scaling a UAE entity through tax or regulatory transitions (e.g., corporate tax rollout)


**Compensation**
 $6,000\-$10,000 / month gross
   

  

**Reporting cadence**
 Reports to: CFO.
   

  

 Direct reports: None at hire. May grow to include UAE\-based operational staff over time.
   

  

 Key cross\-functional partners: Finance, Leadership, HR, Legal counsel, external auditors and bankers.
   

  

 Upward reporting cadence: Weekly 1:1 with CFO; monthly written summary covering compliance, regulator interactions, and operational risks; quarterly strategic review with leadership.
   

  

**Location \& work setup**
* Location: UAE\-based (Dubai preferred), with the ability to be physically present at relevant authorities, banks, and the free\-zone office when needed
* Working hours: Flexible, with reasonable overlap with CET hours (4\+ hours of overlap)
* Employment type: Full\-time


**Benefits**
**Hiring stages**
 We keep our process simple, transparent, and respectful of your time. Here's what to expect:
   

  

* Application screening We carefully review all applications to identify candidates whose background aligns with the role's requirements. You'll receive a timely and transparent update on your application status
* Video intro \+ role fit questionnaire A short async step \- no scheduling required. You'll record a brief video introduction and complete a written questionnaire. This helps us understand who you are, your relevant background, and how your experience aligns with the role without either side committing to a live call upfront
* Discovery HR Interview A conversation with our HR team focused on company and culture match. We'll walk you through how PFM works, what remote ownership looks like in practice, and what success in this role looks like. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and share your goals
* Real\-world task (paid) A short, scoped exercise based on a real PFM UAE operations or regulatory challenge. We compensate for your time because we believe that's the right way to do it. This stage is designed to give both sides a realistic view of the work before committing further
* Peer \& values conversation A conversation with a peer from across the team focused on values, culture, and how you work best. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and get a real feel for life at PFM
* Professional interview You will meet our CFO, to focus on your UAE operations and regulatory expertise — entity governance, banking, tax, free\-zone matters, and how you approach complex regulatory situations. This is the decisive conversation on domain skills and role\-specific experience
* Leadership interview (optional) A conversation with a peer from across the team focused on values, culture, and how you work best. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and get a real feel for life at PFM


 If there's a strong mutual match, we start with an informal conversation to align on expectations, then follow up with a formal written offer. Full transparency throughout, and time for you to make an informed decision.
   

  

 To keep things fully transparent and mutually fair, we complete a reference check before the formal offer is extended. No surprises \- just part of how we make careful, informed decisions on both sides.
   

  

**Before applying take into account that:**
 ▸ If you don't meet every single qualification but believe you can excel in the role based on what it requires \- we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 ▸ We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
   

  

 ▸ Even if it's not listed as a formal requirement, we truly value candidates who have clear familiarity with the prop trading industry and us, our mission and what we do.
   

  

**Not the right fit for this role?**
 If this role isn't the right match but you have experience in trading operations, customer success, compliance, support, partnerships, or a related area \- we still want to hear from you. Join our Talent Pool and we'll reach out when a relevant role opens. Every submission is reviewed, and the pool is always the first place we look before opening a new search.
