data.jd_text:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company’s three core products are Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world; Lens Studio, an augmented reality platform that powers AR across Snapchat and other services; and its AR glasses, Spectacles.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.
   

  

 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Serve as the main day\-to\-day policy representative of Snap Inc in the Middle East and Africa. Further deepen relationships with relevant government officials, NGOs, trade associations, non\-governmental organizations, and other influential stakeholders.
* Work closely with the Senior Director EMEA of Public Policy, the EMEA Public Policy team, the SVP Global Policy \& Platform Operations and, on occasion, the senior executive organization.
* Being the Policy spokesperson of the company in the region in various fora, events etc.
* Be the first to act and respond to the appropriate public policy inquiries.
* Collaborate with Public Policy, Legal and Business teams to analyze legislative initiatives, advise on risks and opportunities and develop company policy positions and messaging
* Partner with the Communications team to help them appropriately respond to Policy\-related media inquiries, by providing the correct policy narrative that best represents Snap Inc.


 Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:
   

  

* A proven ability for shaping, and working with, government officials, NGOs, coalitions and other stakeholder groups.
* Good tech policy understanding and existing relationships within government and the wider stakeholder community in the region.
* Excellent communication and advocacy skills and sound political judgment.
* Forward thinking and proactive ability on legislative, regulatory and public policy issues. Ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues.
* Ability to work with Snap business to identify pertinent issues and orient the public policy team to meet priorities.
* Ability to work independently/ self\-starter in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment
* Demonstrated ability to work with a wide range of external groups and individuals, including those who are opponents or critics.
* Teammate with a positive attitude, motivation and a sense of humor
* Articulate and thoughtful.
* Able to adapt communication on complex issues for different audiences.
* A passion for Snapchat and creativity.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Master's degree or advanced studies in law/economics/public affairs
* 10\+ years relevant experience in MENA public policy and public affairs
* Strong experience (4\+ years) on MENA tech policy, ideally working on platform regulations


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Working experience in Dubai or Riyadh
* Previous experience working with the Government or regulators or other Public institutions is a plus
* Full Arabic and English proficiency necessary


 If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.
   

  

 "Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week.
   

  

 At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. EOE, including disability/vets.
   

  

 Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long\-term success!

data.jd_text:
**Company Description** 




 CyberA Solutions is a UAE\-based Managed Consultation and Services Provider (MCSP) specializing in delivering world\-class cybersecurity solutions to mid\-market organizations. Focused on industries like finance, insurance, and healthcare, CyberA bridges the gap by combining enterprise\-level security consulting with a managed services model tailored to mid\-market challenges. Guided by our 4A Framework—Alignment, Assurance, Armor, and Awareness—we offer a unified security operating model to enhance clients' defenses. Our services include compliance management, security maturity assessments, SOC services, security awareness training, and delivery of advanced protective technologies. Headquartered in the UAE, we are dedicated to simplifying enterprise\-level security for mid\-market businesses.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a
 **Director of Cybersecurity \& GRC** 
 to help design and lead CyberA’s cybersecurity portfolio, services, and delivery capability. The role will own the build\-out of our MCSP offerings (SOC, GRC, offensive security, advisory) and manage a multi\-disciplinary cybersecurity team, working closely with the CISO and CEO on strategy, go\-to\-market, and execution.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who can move seamlessly between client\-facing advisory, internal service design, technical governance of SOC/GRC, and scaling a high\-performance team within a fast\-growing startup.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Define and continuously evolve Cybera’s cybersecurity service catalogue across GRC, SOC\-as\-a\-Service, managed detection, offensive security, and vCISO/advisory offerings.
* Lead design and implementation of cybersecurity frameworks and programmes for clients, including ISO 27001/27017 ISMS, PCI DSS, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800\-171, NCA CST, SAMA, PDPL, and other regional regulations as relevant.
* Architect and govern SOC service offerings (IT and OT where applicable), including SIEM/SOAR strategy, control mapping to MITRE ATT\&CK, and KPI/KRI definitions for SOC performance.
* Collaborate with product/engineering to shape CyberA’s platform roadmap (GRC modules, dashboards, automation, reporting) based on client requirements and regulatory trends.
* Manage and mentor a team of cybersecurity professionals (GRC consultants, SOC engineers/analysts, penetration testers, security architects), establishing clear role definitions, training plans, and progression paths.
* Own quality and consistency of client deliverables: policies and standards, risk registers, treatment plans, audit reports, playbooks, runbooks, and executive presentations.
* Lead or support presales activities: discovery workshops, gap assessments, solution design, proposals, PoCs, and executive briefings with CxO stakeholders.
* Act as senior advisor to C\-level executives and boards on cyber risk, security architecture, and regulatory compliance for key accounts.
* Establish and monitor practice\-level KPIs and OKRs (utilisation, NPS, renewal/upsell rates, time\-to\-value) and report regularly to the CISO and CEO.
* Contribute to thought leadership and capability building: internal playbooks, knowledge\-sharing, training programmes, and possibly a Cybera Academy\-style enablement function for clients and partners.



  





**Required Experience** 



* 10\+ years in cybersecurity, with at least 3–5 years in a leadership role (practice lead, head of cybersecurity, director, senior manager) covering multiple domains (GRC, SOC, offensive security, architecture).
* Demonstrable experience in building or significantly scaling a cybersecurity practice or MSSP function (e.g., service catalogue design, methodology, delivery governance, KPIs).
* Hands\-on experience implementing and maintaining at least three of: ISO 27001/27017, PCI DSS, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800\-171, NCA CST, SAMA, PDPL, or equivalent regional frameworks.
* Proven background in SOC design and governance, SIEM/SOAR projects (QRadar, Splunk, ELK, Resilient, TheHive, etc.), and mapping use cases/controls to MITRE ATT\&CK.
* Strong experience in client\-facing consulting roles with financial services, telecom, government, or critical infrastructure clients.
* Track record of leading and developing technical teams, including hiring, performance management, and competency development.
* Excellent written and spoken English; strong executive communication and presentation skills.



  





**Nice\-to\-have Experience** 



* Prior experience in a GCC\-based MSSP or cybersecurity consulting firm.
* Exposure to cloud security (AWS/Azure) and cloud\-related compliance (ISO 27017, shared responsibility, multi\-tenant SOC).
* Experience contributing to or working with regulators, central banks, or national cybersecurity authorities.
* Familiarity with GRC platforms (e.g., Archer, ServiceNow, Eramba) and building unified control frameworks.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 LA/LI, SABSA, GIAC (GCIH, GCIA, GMON), or equivalent.



  





**What Success Looks Like in 12–18 Months** 



* A clearly defined, market\-ready cybersecurity service portfolio with standard methodologies, templates, and SLAs.
* An operating SOC/GRC function with measurable KPIs and repeatable onboarding of new clients.
* A high\-performing team in place, with robust onboarding, training, and quality governance.
* Strong reference clients and case studies in at least two priority verticals (e.g., financial services and telecom).



  





**Why Join CyberA?** 



* Opportunity to architect and lead a next\-generation MCSP from the ground up.
* Direct impact and visibility, working closely with the CISO and CEO on both strategy and execution.
* Entrepreneurial, fast\-paced environment with the ability to shape the culture, processes, and technology stack.
* Competitive compensation with performance\-based incentives and potential for long\-term upside.

data.jd_text:
We are a leading international law and professional services firm providing legal, corporate and fiduciary services to global corporations, financial institutions, capital market participants and investment fund managers. With a global presence spanning the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we advise on the laws of Bermuda, the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, Guernsey, Ireland and Jersey.
 



  





 We treat everyone as the intelligent professional they are. Our approach is to trust and empower our people to deliver consistently, and enable them to succeed. Diversity is our secret weapon – it’s the sheer breadth of Walkers people that makes us who we are – gathered from across the globe and fluent in languages, jurisdictions and cultures that help us to mirror our clients and keep our own thinking in tune with the world in which we operate.
 



  





**Overview Of Role** 




  





 This role will ideally be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office.
 



 We are keen to hear from qualified candidates in London who are open to relocating to Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore.
 



  





 This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced compliance professional with a background in the legal or professional services sector to join a team dealing with conflicts of interest and client confidentiality matters.
 



  





 Reporting to our Director of Conflicts and joining the OGC team, the successful candidate will assist with the development of a specialised team of conflicts professionals responsible for analysing, advising on and resolving legal and commercial conflicts of interest, information barriers and share dealing requests. This is to ensure we comply with all applicable regulations, professional rules of conduct, contractual terms related to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and protect client relationships and our reputation.
 



  





 Our conflicts analysts assist with the resolution of complex conflicts issues, deal with sensitive confidential matters, and carry out conflict checks associated with share dealing requests and lateral hires into the business.
 



  





 The Senior Conflicts Manager will work closely with the Director of Conflicts on the ongoing development of our policies, controls and processes as they relate to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, information barriers, share dealing and Market Abuse Regulations. This will include optimising our use of tech/automation (including
 *Intapp* 
 ), standardising and simplifying our policies and processes across the Walkers group, and building an optimal team shape that provides agility, efficiency, consistency and excellent service to the business and our clients.
 



  





**Duties, Responsibilities \& Person Specification** 




  




* Day\-to\-day management of conflicts advisors within the relevant time zone (including leading the recruitment of additional conflicts advisors).
* Act as a point of escalation for the team and the business on all legal and commercial conflicts issues, analysing and resolving issues in accordance with applicable regulations, professional rules and Walkers' own policy and procedures.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across Walkers globally, acting as a point of contact in relation to all conflicts and client confidentiality queries and leading communications across the business in this area.
* Together with other senior team members, lead on internal training as it relates to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, share dealing and insider lists.
* Identify any weaknesses or areas for potential improvement in our existing client onboarding system (Intapp Intake) and, working with the Director of Conflicts and the Compliance Business Systems team, recommend enhancements that streamline/simplify processes for team and the business, and/or strengthen our controls.
* Working with the Director of Conflicts and key stakeholders from across the business, develop and deliver a phased programme of work that: (i) rapidly enhances our conflicts offering/service delivery to the business (including through improved time zone coverage/capacity, responsiveness, efficiency and expertise); (ii) enables us to provide a fully centralised conflict checking/analysis function within the next two years.
* Support the Director of Conflicts in driving quality, consistency, service excellence, efficiency, proactivity and adaptability across the Conflicts team.
* Assist the Director of Conflicts in developing and leading people initiatives within the Conflicts team to drive development of expertise and skills, attraction and retention, and fostering a high\-performing, collaborative and open team culture.
* Input into regular reporting to senior management and/or other stakeholders as required.
* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives which impact or relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality.
* Keep abreast with developments in regulation, technology and the market which are relevant to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, market abuse/insider trading, and information barriers.



  





**Education, Skills \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in law, business, finance or another relevant field.
* Experience in a compliance or in\-house legal role in an international law firm or professional services environment.
* Compliance expert with deep technical and practical knowledge of legal conflicts of interest, commercial conflicts and client confidentiality, with some knowledge of Market Abuse Regs.
* Familiarity with Intapp Intake.
* Experience of policy work.
* Experience of people management, including supervision/management of large teams and experience devising and driving people initiatives (including around recruitment and development).
* Proven track record of delivering change and process improvements.
* Experience working in an offshore environment or with offshore structures would be helpful but not required
* Strategic: ability to work in pursuit of a clear strategic direction, align the team's priorities with those of the wider OGC team and the firm, and proactively identify improvements.
* Leadership: ability to lead and inspire the team, drive collaboration and foster a high\-performing team culture.
* Technical: deep knowledge of relevant regulations and professional rules as they relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and an ability to apply these in practice.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills: solutions\-orientated with the ability to interpret complex fact patterns to reach decisions or develop clear recommendations.
* Quality: strong attention to detail and produces high quality work product.
* Judgement: confident taking decisions, with sound judgement of when to escalate issues or seek further opinions.
* Adaptable: willingness to embrace change and uncertainty and manage competing demands in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment; willing to constructively challenge the status quo.
* Communication: strong verbal and written communication skills, ensuring communications are properly targeted, persuasive, accurate and accessible.
* Emotional intelligence: ability to empathise, understand, and manage emotions effectively, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment.
* Collaborative: builds strong and effective relationships with stakeholders and peers; works collaboratively with colleagues across the business. A "one\-team" ethos.
* Commercial: sound, commercially driven decision\-making. A relentless focus on service excellence.
* Familiarity with Intapp.



  





**Other** 




  




* Walkers is a global business and this role may therefore require audio or video conferencing outside of normal business hours.
* This role will be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office. However, our agile working policy does allow some home working each week.
* Some international travel may be required.



  





 Walkers global is an equal opportunity employer. Equality and diversity are key to our global identity and an integral part of our goal to continue being an employer of choice. We are committed to a work environment that supports all individuals irrespective of gender, ethnicity, nationality, race, religion, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other applicable legally protected characteristics. We make every effort to ensure that employment opportunities are open and accessible to all purely on the basis of personal ability.

**About The Role**
 The Art Director is a senior creative delivery role within M\+C Saatchi Sport \& Entertainment Middle East, responsible for leading the visual and conceptual development of sport and events campaigns across the agency's client portfolio.
   

  

 Reporting to the Senior Client Director, the Art Director will take briefs from strategy and account teams and translate them into compelling creative territories, campaign identities, event experiences, and activation assets that perform across all channels and touchpoints.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, high\-output role suited to a creative who understands the energy, pace, and visual language of sport and live events. You will be expected to concept and create at speed, uphold quality standards across a busy client roster, and contribute to the creative direction of the agency's most visible and complex campaigns.
   

  

 The Art Director will play an important role in shaping the agency's creative output \- working across event branding, sponsorship activations, fan engagement, social content and pitch development \- while supporting and developing the wider creative team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Campaign Creative \& Concept Development**
* Lead creative development from brief to delivery across sports and events campaigns, ensuring all work is on\-brief, on\-brand, and commercially sound.
* Translate strategic briefs into visual creative territories, mood boards, campaign frameworks and creative rationales.
* Develop and present multiple creative routes with clarity and confidence, both internally and in client\-facing settings.
* Oversee creative quality and visual consistency across all client touchpoints and across the full campaign lifecycle.


**Sports \& Events Creative**
* Design and develop event identity systems, environmental branding, wayfinding, fan zone concepts and large\-format experiential assets.
* Create campaign visual assets for major sporting events, sponsor activations, athlete partnerships and fan engagement activations.
* Produce creative across OOH, digital, social, print, broadcast and environmental formats as required by client campaigns.
* Stay ahead of design and visual communication trends in global sports marketing, live events and fan culture.


**Client \& Agency Presentations**
* Support the development of new business pitch decks, credentials presentations and agency marketing materials.
* Present creative work to clients with confidence, manage feedback clearly and see revisions through to final artwork.
* Help the agency bring creative ambition to pitches and proposals, positioning M\+C Saatchi S\&E ME as a best\-in\-class creative partner.


**Creative Team \& Production**
* Brief, direct and review work from freelance designers, illustrators, photographers and video producers.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, maintaining quality and meeting deadlines without compromising standards.
* Oversee artwork trafficking and file management, ensuring all assets are delivered to specification for print and digital use.
* Manage relationships with print suppliers, production studios and external creative partners where required.
* Support and mentor junior members of the creative team, helping to build capability and a culture of high standards.


**Cross\-Department Collaboration**
* Work closely across all departments to deliver integrated creative solutions.
* Collaborate with the Social Media team to ensure campaign creative works effectively across all social platforms.
* Contribute to internal creative reviews and help raise the quality of creative output across all agency accounts.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates IT, we are dedicated to staying ahead of the curve by embracing the latest technologies and strategies to streamline integration processes and enhance infrastructure efficiency. As a valued member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing our integration landscape, ensuring smooth data flow and system interoperability across our enterprise platforms. If you are passionate about creating seamless integration solutions and driving technological excellence, we invite you to apply and to contribute to the success of Emirates Group.
   

  

 Join our Agile Delivery team on a mission to create technology solutions that enhance customer experience and drive revenue growth. We focus on leveraging agile methodologies to deliver innovative and secure technology quickly and efficiently. If you are passionate about delivering value, embracing agility, and leading projects in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a key player in our journey to drive success at the Emirates Group.
   

  

**The** 
**Agile Delivery Manager** 
**is responsible for planning, leading, organising and motivating scrum teams, either within a Release Train or outside, to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid methods, in a fast paced environment that may involve multiple business units.**
**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, process, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done practicing servant leadership and encourage discussion, decision making and conflict resolution.
* Lead the Integrated Programme Planning (Lean Start Up). Working with portfolio teams and supporting the Technical Product Manager, drive and facilitate decomposition of Epic Roadmaps into Integrated Program backlog/plans (Features), ready for hand off into team level backlogs.
* Drive Quality and ensure the Definition of Done (DOD) is being followed; ensures each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution. Encourage a sustainable pace adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team. Maintain an agile project management tool (e.g. ScrumDesk, JIRA, etc.).
* Assist in team development through holding teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work; leveraging cross functional team skills to improve product backlog throughput; and mentoring and developing team members. Attend regular stand\-ups and scrum of scrums, in order to understand the team's progress and issues, and to flag up to the team, where necessary, any important external issues of which they need to be aware.
* Supports the Technical Product Manager in managing business expectations and transparency in both product backlog and schedule for all initiatives. Supports IT Service Manager on service management, service performance and continuous improvements.
* Define and manage a well\-defined process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Delivery Management. Implement an agile governance with key ceremonies, drives continuous improvement with constant assessments of velocity (team story point throughput), defect percentage improvements etc. and also ensures that required governance and ceremonies are in place to give visibility and transparency to business stakeholders.
* Assist with the cost estimation / sizing exercise for both near term and future initiatives and assists with preparing total cost of ownership with the product team, maintains the actuals within the allocated budget and also ensure that forecasting for all the demands are accurately done for the FY.
* Together with the Product team, supports the RFx phases in the procurement process and the scheduling of such activities in relation to the product lifecycle.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**
* Degree in Computer Science or equivalent
* Proven leadership and project delivery experience in a matrix organisation with global teams for a large organisation.
* Experience in agile delivery within the context of a large technology change programmes.


**Knowledge/skills**
* Certified SAFe and PMI ACP (additional certifications such as PMI, Prince 2, CSM desirable) with 5\+ Years of practical application of the Scrum Management discipline.
* Well\-versed in the use of tools of software delivery e.g. ServiceNow ITBM, MS OFFICE suite, JIRA, Confluence etc.
* Good architectural knowledge of large scale systems.
* Ability to effectively communicate specialist information in an understandable format to all stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, focusing on core scrum values of openness, honesty and respect.
* Hands\-on leader with strong people skills.


 Leadership Role: Yes
   

  

 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance and more. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

data.jd_text:
A leading global consultancy is seeking a Regional Finance Director to provide strategic direction and expert guidance for their regional finance unit based in Dubai. This pivotal role offers you the opportunity to shape the financial agenda across multiple countries, partnering closely with senior leaders to drive business growth and ensure robust financial management. You would ideally be based in the UAE with proven regional experience.
 



**What you'll do:** 




 As Regional Finance Director, you will be entrusted with overseeing all aspects of financial management across a diverse regional portfolio. Your day\-to\-day responsibilities will involve setting strategic direction for the finance unit, guiding teams through complex challenges, and ensuring high standards of accuracy in reporting. You will work collaboratively with senior leaders to deliver business plans while maintaining rigorous controls that safeguard assets. By establishing clear KPIs and analytics frameworks, you will monitor progress against objectives and provide actionable insights. Your expertise will be crucial in managing statutory audits, preparing detailed accounts for internal and external stakeholders, and supporting company\-wide initiatives such as bid document preparation or project risk reviews. You will also play an integral role in sustainability efforts by sharing responsibility for carbon emissions reduction during project delivery. Success in this role requires you to foster a high\-performing team culture that exceeds expectations while promoting health, safety, wellbeing, and inclusivity throughout the organisation.
 






* Lead the implementation of the regional finance strategy for a designated portfolio, ensuring strategic plans are executed effectively and operational delivery aligns with organisational priorities.
* Maintain an effective financial control environment that mitigates risks of fraud or error, protecting cash, systems, investments, and other assets across the regional portfolio.
* Establish analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) for monitoring the execution of the regional finance strategy, providing clear insights into progress and outcomes.
* Act as a finance business partner to the Managing Director for the region, supporting the execution of business plans and driving commercial success.
* Collaborate with the Chief Finance Officer as part of the finance leadership team, offering expertise and counsel on all strategic finance matters within the designated portfolio.
* Oversee comprehensive financial reporting adhering to international accounting standards (IFRS), managing statutory audits and ensuring accurate accounts across subsidiaries.
* Manage monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc management accounts and reporting requirements to meet statutory, fiduciary, country\-specific obligations.
* Review unallocated staff across the regional portfolio, proactively identifying risks or opportunities that may impact sector financial performance.
* Provide monthly reviews of pipeline prospects with senior business stakeholders, ensuring leads and target gaps are accurately reported for executive summaries.
* Issue regular debtors reports and accrued income reports, taking timely action on invoicing and collections while maintaining compliance with third\-party reporting obligations.







**What you bring:** 




 Your proven experience as Regional Finance Director will demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of financial leadership within complex environments. You bring advanced skills in managing multi\-country portfolios using international accounting standards alongside deep expertise in audit processes. Your full accountancy qualifications underpin your ability to deliver accurate reporting while maintaining rigorous controls. You excel at communicating effectively across all levels\-engaging C\-Suite executives as well as nurturing professional networks externally. Your capacity for analytical thinking enables you to identify risks proactively while leveraging opportunities for improvement. As an inspiring leader who builds cohesive teams focused on shared goals, you are adept at guiding both direct and indirect reports towards exceeding performance targets. Your digital literacy ensures seamless integration of technology into daily operations while your commitment to continuous learning supports ongoing professional development. With significant experience in consultancy or related sectors, you understand industry best practices intimately\-making you an invaluable asset capable of driving transformational change.
 






* Comprehensive expertise in financial leadership within industry settings, demonstrated by a track record of achievement leading large or complex finance units or sub\-functions.
* Advanced knowledge of international accounting standards (IFRS) with proven experience managing statutory audits and preparing accurate financial reports for multi\-country portfolios.
* Highly developed analytical skills combined with advanced budgetary expertise to oversee complex financial planning processes.
* Expertise in audit and risk management practices that ensure robust controls are maintained across all areas of responsibility.
* Full accountancy qualification such as ACA (Associate Chartered Accountant), ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants), CIMA (Chartered Institute of Management Accountants), or equivalent certification.
* Significant relevant experience in finance leadership roles at regional or multi\-country level within consultancy or similar industries.
* Advanced communication skills enabling effective engagement at C\-Suite level as well as building strong relationships with internal teams and external partners including auditors, bankers, insurance brokers, tax advisors, joint venture partners.
* Proven ability to manage direct reports (1\-4\) as well as indirect reports (over 8\), fostering collaborative teamwork that delivers high performance against KPIs \& OKDs.
* Digitally savvy with technical literacy including working proficiency in Oracle systems for efficient data analysis \& reporting.
* Strategic thinking capabilities paired with inspiring leadership qualities that build effective finance teams focused on delivering organisational objectives.







**What's next:** 




 If you are ready to take your career to new heights by joining a collaborative team dedicated to excellence in regional finance leadership, apply now!
 







 Apply today by clicking on the link provided.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates, we believe in connecting the world, to and through our global hub in Dubai, and in constantly innovating to ensure our customers 'Fly Better’.
   

  

 Emirates Group IT thrives on the dynamic nature of technology. Being pioneers in aviation innovation, we're always at the forefront, pushing boundaries. We're on the lookout for exceptional IT professionals to fortify our position as leaders in the industry. Embark on a journey with the world’s largest international airline and become a vital part of our cutting\-edge information and technology team as an
 **Agile Delivery Manager \- SkyCargo** 
 .
   

  

 We are hiring a Delivery Manager with strong experience in Aviation Cargo or Logistics to lead large\-scale, AI\-driven in\-house development initiatives. The role also requires proven expertise in managing RFT processes, vendor selection, and end\-to\-end implementation of technology solutions. The ideal candidate will drive delivery excellence, stakeholder alignment, and innovation across complex, multi\-vendor environments.
   

  

 As the
 **Agile Delivery Manager \- SkyCargo** 
 , you will be responsible for planning, leading, organising, and motivating scrum teams either within a Release Train or outside to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high\-visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid (for Package Acquisition) methods in a fast\-paced environment that may involve multiple business units.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, processes, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done, practicing servant leadership, and encourage discussion, decision making,g and conflict resolution.
* Lead the Integrated Programme Planning (Lean Start Up). Working with portfolio teams and supporting the Technical Product Manager, drive and facilitate decomposition of Epic Roadmaps into Integrated Program backlog/plans (Features), ready for hand off into team\-level backlogs.
* Drive Quality and ensure the Definition of Done (DOD) is being followed; ensure each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution. Encourage a sustainable pace, adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team. Maintain an agile project management tool (e.g., ScrumDesk, JIRA, etc.).
* Assist in team development through holding teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work, leveraging cross\-functional team skills to improve product backlog throughput, and mentoring and developing team members. Attend regular stand\-ups and scrum of scrums, in order to understand the team's progress and issues, and to flag up to the team, where necessary, any important external issues of which they need to be aware.
* Supports the Technical Product Manager in managing business expectations and transparency in both the product backlog and schedule for all initiatives. Supports IT Service Manager on service management, service performance, and continuous improvements.
* Define and manage a well\-defined process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Delivery Management. Implement an agile governance with key ceremonies, drives continuous improvement with constant assessments of velocity (team story point throughput), defect percentage improvements, etc., and also ensures that required governance and ceremonies are in place to give visibility and transparency to business stakeholders.
* Assist with the cost estimation/sizing exercise for both near\-term and future initiatives, and assist with preparing the total cost of ownership with the product team, maintain the actuals within the allocated budget, and ensure that forecasting for all the demands is accurately done for the FY.
* Together with the Product team, supports the RFx phases in the procurement process and the scheduling of such activities in relation to the product lifecycle.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**
* A Degree or Honours (12\+3\) or equivalent in Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering.
* 8\+ years of experience within Information Technology with proven leadership and project delivery experience in a matrix organisation with global teams for a large organisation.
* Experience in agile delivery within the context of a large technology change programme.
* Certified SAFe and PMI ACP (additional certifications such as PMI, PRINCE2, CSM desirable) with 5\+ Years of practical application of the Scrum Management discipline.
* Well\-versed in the use of tools of software delivery, e.g., ServiceNow ITBM, MS OFFICE suite, JIRA, Confluence, etc.
* Good architectural knowledge of large\-scale systems.
* Ability to effectively communicate specialist information in an understandable format to all stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, focusing on core Scrum values of openness, honesty, and respect.
* Hands\-on leader with strong people skills.
* Aviation Cargo or Logistics domain experience is preferred.


**Leadership Role:** 
 Yes
   

  

 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance, and more. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

**Overview**
 Manager – Planning \& Business Solutions for Energy \& Projects vertical supports the execution and delivery of AIT’s Energy \& Projects (E\&P) solutions strategy within the IMEA region. The role focuses on commercial execution, customer support, operational coordination, and product deployment, contributing to sustainable and profitable growth in line with regional and corporate objectives.
   

  

 The Manager partners closely with the Director – Energy \& Projects, regional leadership, and cross‑functional teams to support business development initiatives, ensure operational excellence, and maintain strong relationships with customers and service providers involved in complex Energy and Project logistics solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and coordinate end‑to‑end execution of Energy, Oil \& Gas, and Project Cargo movements across India \& Middle East region, ensuring safety, regulatory compliance, and on‑time delivery.
* Serve as the operational and technical subject‑matter expert for Energy \& Project cargo, including OOG, breakbulk, modules, skids, and engineered movements supporting upstream, midstream, and downstream projects.
* Manage routing, carrier selection, vessel planning, equipment configuration, permits, surveys, and method‑of‑transport execution in alignment with approved SOPs, HSE plans, and EPC requirements.
* Coordinate carriers, heavy‑haul and SPMT providers, ports, terminals, yards, and third‑party service providers to ensure capacity availability, service continuity, and effective risk mitigation in Oil \& Gas environments.

* Support tender execution for Energy \& Oil \& Gas projects through operational feasibility assessments, execution methodology reviews, and pricing inputs within defined authority limits.
* Collaborate with regional pricing and procurement teams to validate rates, equipment availability, and market conditions, sharing intelligence on carrier capacity and cost drivers within the Energy sector.
* Track operational KPIs related to safety, schedule adherence, cost control, and execution quality, implementing corrective actions for deviations.
* Act as a first‑level operational escalation point for complex, high‑risk, or cross‑border Energy \& Project shipments, including shutdowns, critical\-path cargo, and remote site deliveries.

data.jd_text:
**About Zamanat** 




 Zamanat is a Sharia\-aligned real\-world asset tokenisation platform. We structure and tokenise assets across funds, private credit, real estate and receivables, then distribute them through institutional, private wealth and on\-chain channels.
 



  





 We have applied for a DIFC tokenised credit fund and run a live structuring pipeline across receivables, fund and real\-estate mandates in MENA, GCC and selected emerging markets. The structuring lead is a foundational role.
 



  





 AI\-driven playbooks are a core part of Zamanat's growth strategy. We are building a structuring function where AI tools compress time\-to\-launch, accelerate documentation, and turn one\-off deals into repeatable products. The right hire is hungry to learn, prototype and embed AI tooling into the structuring workflow.
 



  





  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring a
 **Director, Structuring \& Originatio** 
 n to lead deal structuring across Zamanat's live and forward pipeline, originate new mandates, and build the structuring playbook that compresses our time\-to\-launch on every subsequent deal. The role is hands\-on today. It is also on a clear path to Senior Director or MD as deal pipeline, AUM and team scale. The right person executes deals personally now and grows into running a structuring desk over the next 18 to 36 months. This is not a pure origination seat and not a back\-office structuring seat. We need someone who can hold a term sheet, a Sharia structure, a regulator conversation, a sponsor relationship and a documentation pack in the same week.
 



  





  





**What You Will Do** 



* Lead end\-to\-end structuring on live mandates across receivables financing, private credit, fund tokenisation and asset\-backed structures
* Originate new mandates alongside the CEO and BD lead, primarily across MENA, GCC, South Asia and Sub\-Saharan Africa
* Codify Zamanat's structuring playbooks. The 12\-month KPI is three named playbooks in production use
* Build AI\-assisted structuring tooling and templates: use AI to fast\-track documentation, term\-sheet drafting, scenario modelling, Sharia structure checks, and deal pattern recognition across the playbook library
* Own commercial term\-sheet design, fee structures and economic alignment with sponsors and partners
* Run Sharia structuring decisions in close coordination with appointed Sharia advisors. Murabaha, Wakala, Sukuk, Ijara, Musharaka and hybrid structures as relevant
* Oversee post\-issuance servicing on SME and receivables programmes including servicing, reporting, performance monitoring and remediation triggers
* Work with regulatory counsel and partner licence\-holders on jurisdictional execution (ADGM, DIFC, DFSA, FSRA, and selected emerging\-market regulators)
* Manage the deal\-team relationship with fund administrators, custodians, tokenisation tech partners and Sharia advisors
* Build and lead the structuring team as pipeline conversion supports it.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 You ha
 **ve 10 to 14 ye** 
 ars of experience in structured finance, capital markets, Islamic finance, private credit, securitisation, receivables financing or specialist arranging. You have personally led deals through structuring, documentation and closing, not just sat on the desk while others closed them. You can run the playbook today and build the team that runs it tomorrow.
 



 You understand both the commercial logic of a deal and the structural mechanics that make it executable. You are comfortable with ambiguity, lean teams and shaping a function from scratch. You are hungry to learn and apply AI tooling to your work. You see AI as core leverage on structuring throughput, not a side experiment.
 



  





**Required Experience** 



* 10 to 14 years in structured finance, capital markets, sukuk, Islamic finance, private credit, securitisation, receivables financing or specialist arranging
* Demonstrable Sharia\-structured execution on live deals. Murabaha, Wakala, Sukuk or Ijara applied in production, not theoretical.
* Capital markets experience including debt capital markets, sukuk issuance, structured notes or asset\-backed transactions
* Receivables financing, factoring, supply\-chain finance or working\-capital programme experience.
* Strong commercial judgement on term sheets, fee structures and sponsor economics.
* Experience working across ADGM, DIFC, DFSA, FSRA or comparable GCC and MENA regulatory environments.
* Ability to manage external counsel, fund administrators, custodians and partner licence\-holders.
* Willingness to learn and embed AI tools in day\-to\-day structuring work. Comfortable using AI for documentation, scenario testing, term\-sheet drafting, structure comparison and pattern recognition across deal libraries.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Private markets experience including private credit funds, real\-estate funds, infrastructure or alternatives
* Tokenisation, digital assets or blockchain\-based issuance exposure
* Direct relationships with mid\-market issuers, sponsors, asset managers and private credit originators across MENA, GCC, South Asia or Sub\-Saharan Africa.
* Prior experience codifying structuring playbooks, templates or repeat\-issuance frameworks.
* Existing exposure to AI tools applied to financial work (deal review, documentation drafting, model build, research synthesis).
* Team build and leadership experience.
* Comfort operating without a large platform underneath, in an early\-stage operating company



  





  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 In the first 90 days, you will have taken ownership of the live structuring book, mapped the forward pipeline, locked priority deal sequencing, started the first playbook codification, and identified the first two or three AI tooling levers for the structuring workflow. In the first 12 months, success means closed mandates with locked fee economics, the first three named structuring playbooks in production, AI tooling embedded in at least two playbooks (with measurable time\-to\-launch compression), a working post\-issuance servicing model on receivables programmes, and a hiring case for the next structuring team member.
 



  





  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive fixed compensation.
* Performance\-linked bonus tied to closed mandates, structuring fee revenue and playbook delivery.
* Equity or carry participation aligned to long\-term value creation
* Clear trajectory to Senior Director or MD as pipeline, AUM and team scale.
* Direct exposure to the CEO, partners, sponsors and Sharia governance.
* A foundational role in building a Sharia\-aligned tokenisation platform from the structuring layer up, with AI tooling embedded into the workflow from inception.

 This is a role with a lot of responsibility and the potential to make a true impact \- on our delivery capability, within the business, and on government across the globe. We look for entrepreneurial people that want to make their mark on the world, and we empower and reward our staff accordingly. There is a lot of room for creativity and big ideas that shift the status quo. We are constantly delivering large new features and complex initiatives.
   

  

 You will report to our Principals and Partners working across all of our cross\-functional delivery teams, closely collaborating with product managers, developers, UI/UX designers, data scientists, business analysts, and QA teams.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 Entrepreneurial and ambitious, with your own perspective and ideas, and with an eagerness to contribute to the success of the organization's delivery excellence.
   

  

 Highly independent and self\-motivated, with strong leadership skills and a get\-things\-done attitude to deliver results.
   

  

 Passion for the public good and eagerness to make a societal impact with their work, ideally with a particular interest in economic development, workforce development, and education.
   

  

 Highly organized and eager to push the boundary on delivery excellence and really rethink traditional project management approaches.
   

  

 Eager to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment that challenges you to excel.
   

  

 Detail\-oriented with high standards for quality and governance.
   

  

**What You'll Do**

 Lead end\-to\-end planning, execution, and closure of complex digital and policy projects from inception through delivery.
   

  

**PMO Governance:** 
 Establish and enforce PMO governance, delivery standards, and reporting frameworks across all projects to ensure consistency and quality.
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 
 Coordinate and drive cross\-functional delivery teams including product, data science, data engineering, AI and BI development to achieve project objectives.
   

  

**Stakeholder Interface:** 
 Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, executive leadership, and technical teams to ensure alignment and transparency.
   

  

**Product Delivery Oversight:** 
 Govern the design, development, validation, and deployment of digital products to ensure they meet quality standards and business requirements.
   

  

**Analytics \& Reporting:** 
 Ensure effective visualization and consumption of insights through Live Jira dashboards and related analytics platforms for real\-time project visibility.
   

  

**Toolset Management:** 
 Manage project delivery using Jira, Confluence and Azure\-based toolsets, ensuring transparency, traceability, and control across all initiatives.
   

  

**Risk \& Issue Management:** 
 Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies to keep projects on track.
   

  

**Scope \& Schedule Control:** 
 Monitor and control scope, schedule, and benefits realization across concurrent initiatives to ensure successful outcomes.
   

  

**Quality Assurance:** 
 Ensure quality and consistency of deliverables through formal reviews and adherence to Whiteshield standards.
   

  

**Executive Reporting:** 
 Provide clear, concise, and regular status reporting to senior stakeholders and steering committees.
   

  

**Resource Optimization:** 
 Optimize resource planning, capacity management, and prioritization across multiple workstreams to maximize efficiency.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills
* Multiple years of experience in project/program management and PMO leadership, preferably in a dynamic, high\-growth and highly innovative environment
* Proven successful experience in delivering complex digital products and technology initiatives from scratch
* Proficiency with relevant tooling (such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, and analytics platforms)
* Professional certifications such as PMP, PMI\-ACP, PRINCE2, or Agile certifications (Scrum Master, SAFe, etc.)
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, and hybrid delivery methodologies with experience adapting frameworks to organizational needs
* Experience with data\-driven decision making and building dashboards/reporting frameworks for executive visibility
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to multitask and resilience to meet deadlines and manage stressful situations
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills and experience with stakeholder management at all levels


**Benefits**
**Inclusive by Design**
 At Whiteshield, we champion equal opportunities \- not just in principle, but in practice. We believe the best ideas grow in spaces where every voice is respected, and every background adds value. Our inclusive culture empowers all team members to bring their whole selves to work, knowing their perspectives are welcomed and their contributions matter.
   

  

**Celebrate the Climb**
 We don't just notice high performance \- we reward it. Whether it's through career advancement or peer recognition, we celebrate those who push boundaries and raise the bar. Your growth is our priority.
   

  

**Flexible, Human\-Centered Work**
 We understand that ambition and wellbeing go hand in hand. That's why we offer flexible working models and a culture that values balance, autonomy, and trust. Whether you're recharging or reaching new heights, we want you to thrive \- both inside and outside the office.
   

  

**Impact with Purpose**
 At Whiteshield, your work drives real change. From shaping national labour strategies to advising global climate policy, we work on challenges that matter. For professionals who want their career to stand for something, this is your platform to make it count.
   

  

**Global Mindset**
 Join an international network of economists, data scientists, policy advisors, and strategists \- all collaborating across borders with a shared mission. Expect sharp minds, open conversations, and a genuine team spirit.

**About Us** 




 Keeta, the international subsidiary of global delivery leader Meituan, is driven by a clear mission: We help people eat better, live better. Building on our parent company's 16 years of technological and operational expertise mastered in China, we are leading a global transformation in food and consumer product delivery. Since our start in 2023, Keeta has focused on creating value for every part of the communities we serve. We provide a reliable experience for consumers, enhance technology and operations for restaurants, and create more earning opportunities and greater safety for courier partners. This commitment to shared progress drives our journey from Hong Kong, China, across the Middle East and into Brazil, with the world ahead.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



1. Build and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to support logistics operations — providing real\-time visibility across delivery performance, courier efficiency, and supply\-demand balance
2. .Lead deep\-dive analytics on key delivery metrics including ATA (Arrival Time Accuracy), order fulfilment rates, and last\-mile efficiency — translating insights into actionable recommendations for operations teams
3. .Develop quantitative models for capacity planning, workforce scheduling, and demand forecasting to support sustainable growth in the UAE market
4. .Own data storytelling for weekly and monthly business reviews — ensuring KPI visibility and driving alignment across cross\-functional stakeholders
5. .Partner with Product, Operations, and Finance teams to define metrics frameworks, evaluate new initiatives, and embed a data\-driven decision\-making culture
6. .Lead and develop a team of 4–5 data analysts — setting direction, building capability, and fostering a high\-performance analytics culture



  





**What We Need From You** 



* 5\+ years of experience in data analytics, with 2\+ years of team management experience.
* Proficiency in SQL and at least one of Python or R — with hands\-on experience building pipelines, dashboards, and analytical models.
* Strong background in internet, technology, or on\-demand platform companies — experience in food delivery, logistics, or last\-mile operations is a strong plus.
* Proven ability to translate complex data into clear business insights and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Fluency in both English and Chinese (Mandarin) — this role operates across a bilingual team environment.
* Bachelor's degree or above in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.



  





**What Makes This Role Exciting** 




 This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of data science and last\-mile delivery operations — with direct impact on how Keeta serves millions of users across the UAE. You'll be reporting into the Head of Logistics and building the data foundation that powers one of the fastest\-growing food delivery platforms in the Middle East. With a newly formed team and a high\-growth market, this is a genuine opportunity to shape how data\-driven decisions are made at scale — from the ground up.
 



  





**Why Join Keeta** 



* **Global scale, local impact** 
 — Keeta is Meituan's international arm, backed by 16 years of technology and operational expertise, and one of the fastest\-growing food delivery platforms in the Middle East.
* **Real ownership from day one** 
 — You'll lead a team, shape data infrastructure, and directly influence how the business makes decisions at scale.
* **Work with top talent globally** 
 — Collaborate with teammates from over 40 countries in a fast\-moving, high\-performance environment.
* **Accelerate your career** 
 — We move fast, operate across multiple markets, and give ambitious people the space to grow beyond what a traditional role could offer.

We are committed to provide our Colleagues at all levels with opportunities to grow and develop within the organisation through personalised development plans and tailored succession planning. Whether it is through animal conservation, education or tree\-planting, we like to give back in as many ways as we can to help our communities flourish.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Director Digital UI/UX is accountable for defining and leading Kerzner International’s digital experience strategy and design execution across the global brand portfolio, including Atlantis, One\&Only, SIRO, and Rare Finds.
   

  

 The role owns the end\-to\-end experience, vision, design quality, and user ‑centred execution across all digital products and channels, ensuring guest journeys are intuitive, premium, accessible, and conversion effective. Acting as the design authority for digital experience, the Director‑ Digital UI/UX establishes experience principles, design systems, and optimisation practices that consistently translate brand intent into high q‑uality digital interactions.
   

  

 The Director Digital UI/UX works in close partnership with the Director Digital Products, who owns commercial outcomes, prioritisation, and platform decisions. Together, the roles ensure digital products deliver measurable business results while maintaining a differentiated, guest centric experience aligned with Kerzner’s luxury positioning.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Digital Experience Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and own Kerzner’s global digital experience strategy across web, mobile, booking, and supporting platforms
* Translate brand, guest, and business objectives into clear experience principles and design direction
* Ensure consistency of experience across brands while allowing for brand specific expression where required
* Act as the senior design authority for all guest facing digital experience


**Guest Journey Design \& Optimisation**
* Lead the design of end\-to\-end guest journeys across discovery, inspiration, booking, and post booking touchpoints
* Drive continuous experience optimisation to improve usability, engagement, and conversion
* Partner with the Director Digital Products to align experience led optimisation initiatives with commercial priorities and targets
* Balance ‑guest centric design with performance, scalability, and delivery constraints


**Design Systems, Standards \& Governance**
* Establish, evolve, and govern Kerzner’s digital design systems, component libraries, and experience standards
* Define UX/UI best practices, accessibility standards, and quality benchmarks
* Ensure consistent application of design standards across internal teams, agencies, and partners
* Review and approve experience and design decisions for major initiatives and releases
* Maintain hands‑on proficiency in industry‑standard tools (e.g. Figma) and emerging AI‑powered design capabilities


**User Research, Insights \& Experimentation**

* Translate insights into actionable design recommendations and priorities
* Collaborate with Product, Data, and Marketing teams to ensure insights inform roadmap and optimisation decisions


**Cross Functional Collaboration \& Delivery**

* Support agile and product oriented delivery models with embedded design practices
* Provide clear executive level communication on experience vision, priorities, and outcomes
* Engage and manage external design agencies and partners to deliver against experience standards

 The Director Digital UI/UX and Director Digital Products operate as peer leaders within the Digital \& Technology leadership team. The Director Digital UI/UX owns experience strategy, design quality, and user ‑centred execution, while the Director Digital Products owns commercial outcomes, prioritisation, platform strategy, and technical decision making. Decisions impacting both domains are made collaboratively, with escalation to the Chief Digital \& Information Officer where required‑.
   

  

**Skills, Experience \& Educational Requirements**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Design, Human Computer Interaction, Digital Media, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
* 10\+ years’ experience in UX/UI, digital experience design, or customer experience roles
* 5\+ years’ experience leading design teams in complex, global digital environments
* Experience in hospitality, luxury, travel, or consumer facing digital platforms preferred


**Design \& Experience Expertise**
* Deep expertise in UX/UI design, interaction design, and experience strategy
* Strong experience designing for complex ecosystems including content, commerce, and booking journeys
* Proven track record of improving conversion and engagement through experience led design
* Strong understanding of accessibility, usability standards, and inclusive design

 The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing all site activities, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality. * Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, stakeholders, authorities, and project partners.

* Drive best practices across project delivery, improving processes, efficiency, and overall project performance.
* Provide clear reporting and project updates to senior leadership and key stakeholders.

**Requirements:** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.

* Minimum 18 years’ experience within construction, project management, or supervision, with a strong track record delivering major developments.

* Experience managing projects under contractual frameworks, including contractor management, claims, variations, and commercial processes.

 This is an excellent opportunity for an established Project Director to play a key role in delivering some of Dubai’s current high\-profile developments.

data.jd_text:
**About Arada**
 Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Sharjah, UAE, Arada was created to build spaces that inspire, connect, and enrich communities. As one of the region’s fastest\-growing master developers, Arada has delivered landmark residential, retail, hospitality, and lifestyle destinations that redefine modern living.
   

  

 At Arada, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and high\-performance culture where talented professionals are empowered to make a meaningful impact on the communities we create.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the independent Cost Control Audit \& Governance function across pre\- and post\-contract stages for Arada’s portfolio. Operating as a mandatory control point, this role ensures absolute baseline integrity, strictly audits commercial recommendations prior to package awards, and enforces rigorous governance over the Forecast Final Cost (FFC) versus project budget, disciplined cost governance, and financial visibility for all projects. The role drives cost strategy, reporting integrity, and team capability development.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Pre\-Award Independent Audit \& Gateway Control
* Mandatory Tender Sign\-Off: Review, audit, and provide formal feedback on all Pre\-Tender Estimates (PTE) and Tender Recommendation Reports before any package finalization.
* Independent Budget Verification: Act as an independent control point to cross\-verify procurement and commercial tender returns against the approved business case.
* Executive Gateway Reporting: Prepare and present concise "Gate Review" commercial analysis briefs to the Project Controls Director, CDO, and CEO, explicitly highlighting budget variances and risks prior to contract award.
* Design\-Stage Cost Checks: Monitor schematic and detailed design progressions to flag budget deviations early, forcing mandatory Value Engineering (VE) triggers if baselines are breached.
* Post\-Award Budget Governance \& FFC Control
* Budget vs. FFC Reconciliation: Own the monthly audit of Budget versus Forecast Final Cost (FFC) across all active assets. Identify and challenge hidden cost overruns or optimistic forecasting by project site teams.
* Contingency Drawdown Audit: Establish and enforce strict governance over project risks and contingencies. Validate that any drawdown request is backed by robust data and contractually justified.
* Trend Log \& Early Warning Governance: Implement and oversee an active Trend Log system to capture potential variations, design changes, and claims weeks before they manifest as formal commercial risks.
* Cost Monitoring, Reporting \& BI Automation
* Data Integrity Auditing: Validate and sign off on all monthly cost reports, cash flow projections, and cost\-to\-complete metrics, ensuring they represent a single source of truth.
* Executive Dashboards: Drive the development of automated, live Power BI dashboards for the C\-suite, focusing strictly on Management by Exception by flagging projects tracking outside a 5% variance threshold.
* Proprietary Benchmarking: Oversee the construction and maintenance of a live internal cost\-per\-square\-foot benchmarking database using historical data from completed Arada phases.
* Team Leadership \& Interface
* Internal Audit Team Management: Manage and mentor Senior Cost Controllers and Analysts, instilling a culture of objective, data\-driven financial auditing.
* Cross\-Departmental Interface: Partner effectively with the established Pre\- and Post\-Contract Commercial, Procurement, and Project Management teams while maintaining strict departmental independence.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
* MRICS certification is highly preferred.


**Experience**
* 12–15 years of experience in cost control, commercial management, or quantity surveying within top\-tier developers or international consultancies in the UAE.


**Technical Skills**
* Deep proficiency in enterprise cost management systems.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong Power BI dashboard development and reporting capabilities.


**Core Competency**
* Exceptional analytical authority with the confidence and credibility to challenge commercial submissions and present objective risk data directly to executive leadership.
