data.jd_text:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking a highly driven self\-starter with exceptional program\-level delivery experience to join Anaplan in UAE. This is a rare, high\-impact opportunity to lay the groundwork and shape the success of our most strategic enterprise customers across the Middle East.
 



 At Anaplan, we are redefining how businesses plan and make decisions through our cutting\-edge Connected Planning platform, powered by our unique deterministic calculation engine and advanced AI capabilities. In this role, you will be at the forefront of this transformation.
 



 You will bring a proven track record of leading complex, high\-stakes implementations—ideally within Supply Chain, Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A), or Workforce Planning. Thriving at the intersection of delivery and strategic advisory, you will scope, negotiate, manage escalations, and serve as an indispensable partner to both customer and internal stakeholders. From C\-level executives to daily end\-users, you will excel at influencing decisions and cementing your status as a trusted advisor.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership position tailor\-made for a delivery expert who can seamlessly orchestrate multiple enterprise programs, ensure strict adherence to budget and scope, and expertly pivot to recover projects that have drifted off track.
 



**Your Impact (What You’ll Do)** 



* **Drive Delivery Excellence:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end Anaplan deployments alongside internal teams and external partners, establishing robust governance, ensuring precise scoping, and proactively uncovering hidden assumptions.
* **Be the Strategic Anchor:** 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery, building alignment with customer stakeholders ranging from operational leads up to the C\-suite.
* **Master Complex Programs:** 
 Navigate intricate, multi\-faceted programs, ensuring flawless delivery while expertly balancing scope, risk, budget, and resourcing.
* **Accelerate Decision\-Making:** 
 Anticipate bottlenecks and drive critical project decisions across design, testing, timelines, and organizational change management.
* **Build Consensus:** 
 Leverage top\-tier negotiation skills to resolve conflicts, maintain project momentum, and unite diverse teams behind a shared goal.
* **Champion Excellence:** 
 Advocate for and implement the "Anaplan Way" methodology, ensuring the delivery of scalable, highly intuitive, and user\-friendly solutions.
* **Deliver Transparency:** 
 Provide clear, actionable reporting on project status and overall portfolio health to both internal leadership and external stakeholders.



**Your DNA (What You Bring)** 



* **Enterprise Expertise:** 
 Demonstrable history of exemplary program or project management across complex, large\-scale enterprise initiatives.
* **Agile Mastery:** 
 Deep, hands\-on experience in Agile project delivery methodologies—this is essential for driving our fast\-paced implementations.
* **Turnaround Architect:** 
 Proven ability to recover and realign complex projects led by partners or vendors. We are looking for a track record of delivering—and rescuing—large\-scale projects under tight timelines and budgets.
* **Executive Influence:** 
 Exceptional customer engagement and communication skills, characterized by the ability to negotiate, influence senior leadership, and confidently act as a trusted strategic advisor.
* **Domain Knowledge (Bonus):** 
 While not strictly essential, domain expertise in Supply Chain, FP\&A, or Workforce Planning will highly differentiate your application.



**Why Join Us?** 
 As the first Principal Solution Implementation Manager in the region, you won't just be managing projects; you will be building a legacy. You'll work with industry\-defining AI and planning technology, partner with the world's leading brands, and have a tangible impact on how global enterprises operate.
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

**Company Description** 




 Golden Square Engineering Consultants (GS), founded in 2001, is a leading multi\-disciplinary planning and design firm offering innovative architectural and engineering consulting services in the UAE and the MENA region. Dedicated to sustainable, energy\-efficient green building solutions, GS collaborates with clients and contractors across public and private sectors to deliver high\-quality projects on time and within budget. With offices in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Sharjah, Baghdad, and Canada, GS specializes in designing landmark industrial, residential, commercial, and institutional facilities. Known for its client\-focused approach, the firm provides integrated consulting services, emphasizing integrity, excellence, and value creation in every project.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 Senior Interior Designer
 



**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE
 



**Department:** 
 Interior Design
 



**Reports To:** 
 Design Director / Head of Design
 




 § 
 
**Position Overview** 




 We are seeking a highly creative and technically proficient Senior Interior Designer to join our multidisciplinary architectural consultancy team in Dubai. The successful candidate will lead interior design projects from concept development through detailed design and tender documentation stages, ensuring exceptional design quality, technical accuracy, and compliance with local regulations and international standards.
 



 The ideal candidate will possess strong design leadership skills, extensive consultancy experience, and a proven track record in delivering residential, hospitality, commercial, mixed\-use, and high\-end projects within the UAE and GCC region.
 




 § 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

 v Lead the development of innovative and creative interior design concepts aligned with client objectives, project requirements, and brand standards.
 



 v Prepare concept presentations, mood boards, material palettes, space planning layouts, and design narratives.
 



 v Develop schematic and design development packages, ensuring consistency of design intent throughout the project lifecycle.
 



 v Conduct client presentations and workshops, effectively communicating design concepts and recommendations.
 



 v Collaborate closely with architects, landscape designers, and engineering disciplines to ensure integrated design solutions.
 



**Detailed Design** 




 v Produce and oversee detailed interior design drawings, including plans, elevations, sections, reflected ceiling plans, bespoke joinery details, and construction details.
 



 v Prepare material specifications, finish schedules, FF\&E schedules, and technical documentation.
 



 v Ensure compliance with Dubai Municipality requirements, local authority regulations, building codes, accessibility standards, and project\-specific guidelines.
 



 v Coordinate design deliverables with architectural, structural, MEP, and specialist consultants.
 



 v Review and resolve technical design challenges while maintaining design integrity.
 



**Tender Documentation** 




 v Lead the preparation of comprehensive tender packages, including detailed drawings, specifications, schedules, and scope documentation.
 



 v Assist in preparing Bills of Quantities (BOQ) and technical specifications.
 



 v Review contractor queries during tender stages and provide technical clarifications.
 



 v Evaluate contractor submissions, shop drawings, material submittals, and value engineering proposals.

**Project Coordination \& Delivery**

 v Attend client meetings, consultant coordination meetings, and design review workshops.

**Qualifications**

 v Demonstrated experience in concept design, design development, detailed design, and tender documentation.

**Technical Skills** 




 v Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD and Revit.
 



 v Strong knowledge of BIM workflows and project coordination.
 



 v Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator).
 



 v Experience with SketchUp, Enscape, Lumion, 3ds Max, or similar visualization software.
 



 v Strong understanding of construction methodologies, detailing, materials, and specifications.
 



 v Knowledge of Dubai Municipality regulations, UAE building codes, and authority approval processes.
 



**Competencies** 




 v Excellent design, presentation, and visualization skills.
 



 v Strong technical detailing and documentation capabilities.
 



 v Exceptional communication and client\-facing skills.
 



 v Ability to manage multiple deadlines and projects simultaneously.
 



 v Strong leadership, mentoring, and team management skills.
 



 v Commercial awareness and problem\-solving ability.
 


* v High attention to detail and commitment to design excellence.

data.jd_text:
**Responsibilities:** 



* Provide inputs to the development of the overall division strategy and participate in developing the business unit strategy in line with the vision, mission, and business objectives of the company.
* Deliver the Facilities Management strategy while ensuring contractual commitments are successfully met.
* Manage the effective achievement of the business unit’s objectives through leading the Facilities and Operations team in the assigned project, by setting individual objectives, managing performance, developing and motivating staff, and providing formal and informal feedback and appraisals in order to maximize the subordinates’ and the business unit’s performance.
* Contribute and assist the director of operations in defining an optimum structure for the business unit/ division so that resources are optimally utilized, and communication takes place in an efficient manner.
* Recommend and oversee the budget for the business unit and monitor financial performance versus the budget so that the business is aware of anticipated costs/ revenues, areas of unsatisfactory performance and potential areas of cost reduction are identified, and performance improvement opportunities are realized.
* Lead and manage the Facilities Management function while ensuring the planning and allocation of all resources, and the implementation of the appropriate standards and controls to ensure that all the unit activities are carried out in an efficient and effective manner to meet and exceed unit objectives.
* Discuss “Side\-Specific\-Budgets” with customers including CAPEX for example, advise the customers on expenditures, opportunities for cost reductions, and the viability/ feasibility of changing/ buying assets (such as changing a chiller for example) to ensure customers’ budgeting is as appropriate and as accurate as possible.
* Develop and monitor SLAs for the assets, and ensure that they are aligned to service delivery, client expectations, and expectations from suppliers / service partners in order to achieve quality service delivery, effective supplier relationship management, and profitability.
* Monitor service delivery performance and lead the evaluation of suppliers’ performance to ensure the selection of appropriately qualified service providers at the optimum price in order to deliver the expected quality of service.
* Monitor resource utilization to ensure that the right number and talent is available for running operations (projects, civil works, mechanical works, electrical works, landscaping, building inspections, etc.), accomplishing targets, improving customer satisfaction, and achieving business objectives.
* Monitor and control the execution of maintenance contracts, review the preventive and corrective maintenance programs, and supervise the implementation by employees or assigned contractor(s) through reviewing reports and spot\-checking as appropriate to ensure the provision of quality maintenance works to the facilities (including maintenance to audio visual equipment, BMS, chillers, generators, HVAC, IT, etc.).
* Attend all coordination meetings with the tenants and contractors to discuss the progress of the fit out works and collect the required documentation, carry out an overall inspection after the completion of the fit out works, prepare the snag list to for the tenant, and follow up on all rectification works needed.
* Monitor the request for quotations and the preparation of Purchase Orders and Vendor Contracts, approve same, and ensure that the purchasing process is optimized to guarantee the provision of products/ services to the company/ customer on time and avoid any operational delays.
* Ensure that the Annual Leave Planer is completed to have a holistic view on forecasted leaves and employees’ availabilities throughout the year so as to guarantee that the appropriate resourcing is done and that business operations do not get interrupted.
* Manage customers’ expectations through clear communication and transparent work attitude in order to be consistent and to develop strong customer relationships.
* Receive escalated problems and complaints from the Call Centre and ensure that the necessary support and maintenance work is provided to customers in a timely fashion in order to resolve customers’ issues (pertaining to cooling, power, ventilation, plumbing, etc.) and maintain their high levels of satisfaction.
* Escort customers on daily tours within the premises/ facilities, listen to any feedback or complaints they might have, and delegate any work needed to the subordinates in order to provide customers with the necessary civil, mechanical, electrical, etc. support and maintenance support.
* Provide technical advice to customers and represent customers in technical interfaces with third parties (such as dealing with contractors conducting any construction work on premises while ensuring that they are delivering according to the agreement) as well as furnish customers with technical advice on improvement opportunities (such as reducing utility consumption and bills) in order to increase CSR awareness and contribute in achieving a greener environment.
* Manage the implementation and improvement of policies, guidelines, and processes for contract management and administration to ensure standards are set so that all business requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality service to customers in line with the corporate strategy.
* Manage the process of revising contracts’ scope of work, renewing the contract while recommending changes, conducting pricing, and negotiating the contract with the customer while coordinating the Terms \& Conditions of the contract with the Legal department to ensure alignment with internal policies and any external laws and regulations.
* Lead and monitor the subcontracting of works (such as fire systems, gas, emergency lighting, vertical transportation, water treatment, tank cleaning, etc.), ensure that subcontractors fulfil their duties in an accurate manner and as per the agreed upon contractual clauses, and manage subcontractors’ evaluations and negotiations while ensuring that chosen subcontractors are approved by the relevant authorities to guarantee compliance with the regulatory framework (such as any approvals needed from the Civil Defense Department for fire\-fighting systems).
* Ensure effective planning and implementation of HSEEQ inspections and audits in order to meet regulatory requirements and company standards.
* Monitor physical and documentation audits being conducted on subcontractors to ensure that work is being conducted properly and that customers are being served with the highest quality standards, and take the necessary actions upon the detection of unreported/ undisclosed variations and/ or poor performance to safeguard the company against any liabilities.
* Lead the audits of staff, customers, and suppliers to gather feedback and monitor satisfaction in order to improve the operations and facilities management services the company provides.
* Develop and ensure the implementation of division policies, procedures, and controls covering all areas of activity so that all relevant procedural/ legislative requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality and cost\-effective service.
* Ensure compliance to all relevant quality, health, safety, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls across the department to guarantee employee safety, legislative compliance, delivery of high quality products/ service and a responsible environmental attitude.
* Ensure corrective actions and preventive actions issued by the HSEEQ department are implemented, update the HSEEQ department about the progress of the implementation.
* Ensure the legionella reporting is timely sent to HSEEQ department.
* Ensure the HIRAs are finalized and yearly updated, with support of the HSEQ department.
* Ensure the risk control measures arising from the HIRA are properly implemented.
* Ensure availability of MS and RA



  





**Qualifications, Experiences, Skills**



* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, preferably with a Master’s degree in Management or Facilities Management; CMMS knowledge is also preferable
* 10 – 12 years’ experience in operations management including 5 years in a managerial role; exposure to Maintenance and Facilities Management in hospitality projects.

* Proven track record of managing luxury hospitality and high\-end residential projects from inception to completion.
* Experience working within client or developer organizations preferred.
* Strong knowledge of FIDIC\-based contracts, local permitting processes, and regional construction practices.



  





 Skills \& Attributes
 


* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong financial acumen and ability to manage budgets and forecasts.
* High attention to detail with a commitment to delivering excellence.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with multicultural teams.

**Job Description**
**Job Description**
 Are you ready to lead a busy Operations Control Centre that coordinates operational safety, efficiency and resilience across our network? At
 **SolitAir** 
 , we’re seeking an experienced and adaptable leader to establish and head the Integrated Operations Control Centre (IOCC). This role will set the strategy, build the team, and oversee integrated operational control functions that ensure safe, compliant and on\-time service delivery.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
**As Head Of IOCC, You Will**
* Establish and operationally manage the IOCC, including staffing, processes, tools and performance metrics to deliver 24/7 operational control.
* Lead cross\-functional coordination between flight operations, maintenance control, ground operations, cargo planning, safety, and regulatory liaison to resolve disruptions and maintain continuity.
* Drive problem solving for complex operational events by applying structured analysis, root cause identification, and timely corrective actions to minimise impact on safety and schedule.
* Develop flexible operating procedures and escalation frameworks to respond to dynamic operational conditions, including irregular operations, AOG events and severe weather.
* Implement and maintain integrated systems and dashboards that provide real\-time situational awareness and decision support for IOCC staff and senior leadership.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement, capturing lessons learned, training requirements and process enhancements to reduce recurrence of operational disruptions.
* Ensure all IOCC activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements and company policies, and coordinate timely reporting to regulators and stakeholders as required.
* Provide clear, effective communication in English across internal teams and external partners during normal and contingency operations.


****What We’re Looking For****
* Experience: Proven background in airline or aviation operational control roles, with significant experience leading operational teams and managing irregular operations.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical capability and structured problem solving skills, able to lead investigations, define root causes and implement robust corrective actions.
* Flexibility: Demonstrated adaptability to changing priorities and operational pressures; comfortable leading a 24/7 function with variable hours and rapid decision\-making demands. This means you are likely to work over weekends and/or evenings as operational demands require.
* English: Excellent written and spoken English with the ability to prepare clear reports, brief senior leadership and communicate effectively across diverse teams.
* Leadership \& Communication: Strong people leadership skills, able to recruit, develop and motivate a high\-performing, inclusive team; confident at stakeholder engagement and crisis communication.
* Systems \& Data: Comfortable with operational control systems, real\-time dashboards and data\-driven decision making; experience with industry tools is desirable.
* Qualifications: Relevant degree or professional qualifications in aviation, operations management or related field preferred.


 At SolitAir, every role contributes to shaping the future of cargo aviation. We welcome applicants who bring practical experience, a collaborative mindset, and a commitment to operational excellence. This is a gender neutral role and we are committed to providing equal opportunities for all candidates.

**Title : Proxy Product Owner \- Trade** 




**Contract Duration : 6 Months** 




**Location : Dubai** 




  





**Job Purpose** 




 The Proxy Product Owner – Trade Products is responsible for supporting the implementation and ongoing development of Trade Finance system and solution rollout within the GTB product portfolio. The role acts as the bridge between Product Management, Technology, Operations, and business stakeholders, ensuring accurate translation of product vision into detailed requirements, prioritised backlogs, and high‑quality delivery across operational processes, transaction workflows, and client experience.
 



  





**Key Result Areas** 




**Key Responsibilities** 



* Act as Proxy Product Owner for the Trade Finance product set, supporting the Product Owner / Head of Trade Product in driving implementation and enhancements while ensuring consistency across markets and platforms.
* Own and manage the Trade Product Delivery Backlog, working closely with Product Management, PMO, Technology, and Operations to ensure priorities are clearly defined, refined, and aligned with business outcomes, regulatory requirements, and client expectations.
* Translate high level product vision into detailed business and functional requirements, ensuring clarity on scope, acceptance criteria, and dependencies for development teams.
* Provide Trade Finance domain expertise to delivery teams, covering products, operational processes, controls, and end‑to‑end client journeys, and act as a subject‑matter reference during development and implementation.



  





**Support Product Management by:** 



* Ensuring active participation of relevant SMEs in working‑level product forums
* Assisting in the creation and validation of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), user stories, test cases, standard operating procedures, and implementation guides
* Regularly engaging with the Head of Product and Trade Product Owner to track progress, risks, and delivery readiness



  





**Key Measures**



* Delivery Effectiveness – backlog readiness, delivery accuracy, and timely implementation
* Product Enhancements – successful delivery of approved enhancements and fixes
* Client Experience – speed, usability, and frictionless client journeys
* Product Governance – adherence to GTB, compliance, and risk frameworks
* Stakeholder Satisfaction – effective engagement with Product, Technology, Operations, and Business
* Team Enablement – contribution to team effectiveness and knowledge sharing



  





**Operating Environment, Framework and Boundaries, Working Relationships** 




 The role operates in a fast‑evolving Transaction Banking environment where processes are increasingly digitised and deployed across client ecosystems. A solid understanding of trade fundamentals, digital platforms, APIs and agile delivery models is essential.
 



 The Proxy Product Owner must balance rapid delivery with regulatory and control requirements, working closely with Technology, Operations, Vendors, Risk, Compliance, and GTB Product Management. Strong collaboration with Sales and Coverage teams is also required to ensure client needs and market insights feed into product prioritisation.
 



  





**Problem Solving** 



* Apply a data‑ and analytics‑driven approach to identify issues, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
* Develop a strong understanding of client pain points and operational bottlenecks to inform prioritisation decisions.
* Challenge delivery teams to consider simpler, digital‑first solutions, including buy vs. build options and partnerships with fintechs where appropriate.
* Work with Operations and Technology to identify opportunities for process re‑engineering, automation, and digitisation.
* Stay current on industry, technology, and fintech trends relevant to Trade and Supply Chain Finance.



  





**Decision Making Authority \& Responsibility** 



* Day‑to‑day ownership of the Trade product backlog and delivery priorities as delegated by the Head of Trade Product and Trade Product owner
* Accountability for requirements quality, delivery readiness, and functional sign‑off for Trade product developments and enhancements
* Functional oversight of Business Analysts supporting Trade and Supply Chain Finance initiative



  





**Knowledge, Skills and Experience** 



* Minimum 10 years’ experience in Trade Finance product development or delivery within banking
* Strong experience with agile product delivery and working alongside Technology teams
* Deep understanding of Trade Finance products, processes, and controls
* Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and prioritisation skills
* Effective stakeholder management and communication skills with senior leadership impact

**Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award\-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest\-growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
   

  

**Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers
* Proficient with editing software (Premiere Pro is required; After Effects, etc.)
* Excellent creativity, communication, and attention to detail
* Social\-first mindset with a deep understanding of digital and platform\-native video content


**Benefits**
* Monthly "Self Love Days" (at company discretion)
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in\-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting


*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

data.jd_text:
AESG is seeking an accomplished Principal Mechanical Engineer with deep expertise in mission\-critical facility design to join our growing Mission Critical department.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead diverse data center projects across the EMEA region, spanning full design delivery, technical advisory services, and contractor support during construction phases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in mechanical systems design with proven client management skills, business development acumen, and the political savvy to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone ready to take the next step in their career while maintaining hands\-on involvement across the full project lifecycle—from early\-stage advisory through design development to construction oversight and commissioning support.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre mechanical systems, including chilled water plant design (chillers, pumps, distribution systems), air handling and distribution (CRAH/CRAC units, ducting, containment strategies), high\-density cooling solutions (direct liquid cooling, rear\-door heat exchangers), fire suppression systems (clean agent, water\-based), and energy\-efficient HVAC design incorporating economizers and free cooling strategies
* Strong technical foundation in load calculations, thermal modelling, pipe sizing, hydraulic calculations, and system balancing for mission\-critical environments
* Proven track record delivering projects for major data centre owners, operators, or developers, with experience across multiple project delivery models, including design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and advisory engagements
* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant mechanical engineering standards including ASHRAE (90\.1, TC 9\.9\), NFPA codes, and energy efficiency metrics (PUE, DCiE)
* Strong client relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage senior\-level client interactions and build lasting partnerships
* Business development experience, including proposal leadership, technical presentations, scope definition, and fee negotiation
* Demonstrated political acumen and ability to navigate complex organizational environments, manage competing stakeholder interests, and operate effectively in matrix structures
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline; Chartered Engineer (CEng) or Professional Engineer (PE) status strongly preferred


**Responsibilities**
* Lead mechanical systems design for data centre and mission\-critical projects across various delivery models—from full design responsibility to technical advisory services and construction phase support—including cooling infrastructure (air\-cooled, liquid\-cooled, hybrid systems), HVAC, fire suppression, and plumbing systems
* Act as a senior client\-facing technical lead, managing relationships with data centre owners, operators, developers, and construction contractors throughout project lifecycles
* Provide technical advisory services to clients during procurement, design review, and construction phases, including contractor submittal reviews, RFI resolution, and technical assurance for project delivery
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, ensuring seamless integration between mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, and other design disciplines
* Supervise, mentor, and develop engineering teams, providing technical guidance and fostering professional growth among junior and mid\-level engineers
* Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, technical presentations, fee negotiations, and strategic client engagement

data.jd_text:
**Life at Dubai Future Foundation** 




 Dubai Future Foundation (DFF) aims to realize the wise vision of Dubai’s leadership to institutionalize the envisioned future and forward\-thinking methodologies, while positioning Dubai as the leading city of the future. In partnership with its local and global partners from governments, companies, startups, and entrepreneurs, DFF drives joint efforts to collectively imagine, design, and execute the best possible future for humanity.
 



 Under the supervision of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Chairman of the Executive Council of Dubai, and Chairman of the Board of Trustees of DFF, the DFF runs and oversees many futureproofing projects and initiatives, such as the Museum of the Future, Area 2071, The Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution UAE, Dubai Future Accelerators, One Million Arab Coders, Dubai Future Academy, Dubai Future Solutions, Dubai Future Labs, Dubai Future Forum, etc. DFF’s efforts to share knowledge, adopt innovation, support entrepreneurs and innovative startups, build capacity, and promote forward\-thinking and foresight principles contribute to Dubai’s ambitions to be a role model for the cities of the future through the power of unlimited imagination, innovation, foresight and disruptive mindset.
 



 For more information on the initiatives, projects, and programs of Dubai Future Foundation, please visit the website:www.dubaifuture.ae
 



  





  





  





**Life at Research, Development \& Innovation (RDI)** 




 Research, Development \& Innovation (RDI) is Dubai Future Foundation’s dedicated research arm, established to advance applied and frontier research that directly shapes Dubai’s innovation agenda. RDI will house multiple specialised research centers, each focused on distinct domains, creating a collaborative ecosystem where deep expertise converges to address the most complex challenges facing cities and societies of the future. Through strategic partnerships with leading academic institutions, global think tanks, and government entities, RDI translates emerging knowledge into actionable insights, policy recommendations, and real\-world impact at a local, regional, and global scale.
 



  





  





  





**Where does this role fit into the bigger picture?** 




 This role bridges the gap between business needs and technology delivery, working hand\-in\-hand with the Head of Technology to translate strategic objectives into actionable system and process requirements. It is essential to ensuring that digital platforms, research tools, and innovation initiatives are designed around real user needs and organizational priorities.
 



  





**Business Analyst** 




 As the Business Analyst, you will work closely with the Head of Technology and cross\-functional teams to gather, analyze, and document business and system requirements that drive the development and optimization of technology solutions. You will serve as the critical link between stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring that digital initiatives are aligned with RDI’s research, development, and innovation strategy.
 



 The Business Analyst will support the delivery of IT and data platforms by translating complex business challenges into clear functional specifications, process models, and system design recommendations.
 



  





  





  





**Your Responsibilities** 




 • You will collaborate closely with the Head of Technology to define and deliver technology solutions that support the research, development and innovation program strategy.
 



 • You will discover, document, and validate business and functional requirements from stakeholders across departments, ensuring clarity and alignment before development begins.
 



 • You will perform system analysis to assess current\-state processes and systems, identifying gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
 



 • You will produce detailed business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specifications, user stories, process flow diagrams, and use cases.
 



 • You will support the delivery of digital projects such as the Trusted Research Environment (TRE), collaboration portals, CRM systems, and IP management platforms, ERP systems, etc.
 



 • You will explore and evaluate the application of agentic AI systems and data\-driven tools to enhance research workflows, automate routine processes, and unlock new analytical capabilities across RDI’s platforms.
 



 • You will manage requirements backlogs within infrastructure projects (Azure), ensuring traceability from business need to technical delivery.
 



 • You will conduct user acceptance testing (UAT), coordinate with end users, and validate that delivered solutions meet defined requirements.
 



 • You will support data analysis and reporting needs, working with internal teams and external research partners , including academic institutions, global think tanks, and government entities, to define data structures, dashboards, and reporting frameworks, operating comfortably within RDI’s diverse partner ecosystem.
 



 • You will assist in the evaluation of third\-party vendors and platforms by documenting technical requirements and participating in RFP and assessment processes.
 



 • You will produce user guides, training materials, and SOPs to support adoption of new systems and processes across teams.
 



 • You will support organisational change management as new systems, platforms, and processes are introduced across RDI , including stakeholder communication, training coordination, adoption tracking, and feedback collection to ensure smooth transitions.
 



 • You will stay current on emerging technologies and best practices in business analysis, recommending process and system improvements to enable research excellence.
 



  





  





  





**Why this role is important?** 




 This role is central to ensuring that technology investments deliver real business value. By bridging stakeholder needs and IT delivery, the Business Analyst enables faster, more effective deployment of digital solutions that power RDI’s innovation and research agenda.
 



  





  





  





**What Dubai Future Foundation offers?** 




 We will offer you a unique opportunity to work with people who are passionate about the future and establishing Dubai as one of the leading cities of the world. You will have the chance to work on exciting and new projects, work in a highly diverse and fast paced environment that fosters creativity, disruptive ideas, and innovation.
 



  





  





  





**Who We're Looking For?** 




 • You will have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
 



 • You will have a minimum of 1 \-2 years of experience in business analysis, with demonstrated ability to work on complex IT or digital transformation projects.
 



 • You will have experience working closely with IT teams and managers, translating technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.
 



 • You will have proficiency in Agile methodologies with hands\-on experience for backlog management and requirements tracking.
 



 • You will have strong skills in process modelling, requirements documentation, and use case development using tools. BPMN 2\.0 notation knowledge is a plus.
 



 • You will have experience with systems analysis, including current\-state assessment, gap analysis, and solution design , prior experience as a Systems Analyst is a strong plus.

 Fleet Technical Management at Emirates comprises five specialized teams dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of service and reliability for our fleet.
   

  

**Airframe Systems:** 
 Handles mechanical systems including flight controls, landing gear, and air conditioning.
   

  

**Structures** 
 : Supports aircraft structures, including repairs and modifications for metallic and composite parts.
   

  

**Avionics** 
 : Manages avionics systems, including navigation, communications, and advanced IFE systems.
   

  

**Powerplant** 
 : Oversees engines and APUs, focusing on health monitoring and optimization.
   

  

**Cabin** 
 : Maintains passenger cabins, flight decks, and retrofits, ensuring top\-notch comfort and functionality.
   

  

 Each team ensures our fleet operates efficiently and safely, meeting all technical and service standards.
   

  

 As a Technical Services Engineer I (Cabin Technical and Reconfigurations) you will provide fleet technical management, continuing airworthiness management and technical support functions for Emirates fleet to ensure compliance to regulatory \& safety requirements, reliability, passenger comfort and cost effectiveness.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Provide fleet technical management, continuing airworthiness management and technical support functions for Airframe/Mechanical Systems.
* Routinely evaluate manufacturers/regulatory authorities’ technical documents, taking appropriate actions and update internal engineering documents including Engineering Order and Special Engineering Workcard.
* Review in\-service data (e.g Tech log, Pilot Reports, Defects) and implement actions to improve fleet, engine, component and/or system reliability and maintainability, including optimisation of aircraft maintenance programs.
* Deliver technical assistance and operational support in disruptions scenarios including the handling of technical/AOG, troubleshooting, aircraft chronic and deferred defects and technical delays.
* Carry out Emirates Engineering design organisational activities such as but not limited to development of standard operating procedures, in house repairs, use of alternate parts, deviations from manufacturing documents by exercising Design Engineer (DE) privileges of Part 21 Design Organisation as appointed by Head of Design (HOD).
* Provide support and expertise for acquisition of new Aircraft and end of lease activities
* Act as a technical liaison with Aircraft, Engines and/or Component Manufacturers and internal stakeholders (e.g flight operations, service delivery) to address fleet significant faults, defects, design issues and quality escapements.
* Provide technical clarifications/justification to internal stakeholders in support of cost optimisation, contract negotiation, repair and modification processes.
* Carry out project management functions such as but not limited to major modifications, retrofits, cabin reconfigurations and aircraft phaseout requirements including preparation of cost benefit studies or budget requirements on changes/repairs with recommendations/proposals for approval by management.
* Review and analyse technical data in support of department KPIs, highlighting trends and making recommendation reports/proposal for improvement.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role you must meet the below requirements:**
* Degree or Honours (12\+3 or equivalent).
* More than 10 years of experience in Engineering, Aeronautical.
* Degree in Aeronautical/Avionics/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering and/or holder of Aircraft Maintenance Engineering Licence for 5 years.
* Related Aircraft Engineering experience.
* Should have a minimum of 8 years in Technical Services function of which at least 5 years of experience pertaining to Emirates fleet type/aircraft systems.
* Knowledge of latest technical developments and industry trends on respective systems.
* Ability to analyse and synthesise technical information for implementation in cost effective ways.
* Excellent drafting/report writing skills.
* Demonstrable experience in managing complex tasks and decision making in a fast\-paced environment.


 Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary.
   

  

 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance and more. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

data.jd_text:
**Job Overview**
 The Head of Categories will lead the development, execution, and performance of Mumzworld’s category portfolio (maternity, feeding, gear, toys, clothing, etc.). This role holds full accountability for category strategy, P\&L, assortment curation, vendor and brand partnerships, pricing, inventory lifecycle management, and cross\-functional delivery across the UAE and KSA to drive sustainable growth, profitability, and an outstanding customer experience.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Strategy \& P\&L Management**
* Define and deliver a 12–24–36 month category roadmap aligned with Mumzworld’s vision, identifying growth segments and white spaces.
* Own full P\&L, driving revenue growth and market share while optimizing margins, COGS, promotions, markdowns, and returns.
* Present performance, risks, and strategic initiatives to Leadership and Board; ensure compliance with UAE/KSA regulations.


**Assortment \& Partnerships**
* Curate optimal assortment (brands, SKUs, exclusives), rationalize underperforming lines, and manage lifecycle.
* Source, negotiate, and onboard local and global brands; secure competitive terms, exclusives, and co\-marketing opportunities.
* Design pricing, promotions, and bundling strategies to optimize conversion, margin, and customer value.


**Supply Chain, Digital \& Ops**
* Partner with Demand Planning and Fulfillment to ensure optimal stock availability and inventory efficiency.
* Work with Product, UX, and Merchandising teams to optimize digital shelf experience for English and Arabic users.
* Use data insights (basket size, conversion, churn, returns, competitor trends) to refine strategy and execution.


**Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Lead and develop a high\-performing category team across UAE and KSA, fostering a data\-driven culture.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Logistics, Finance, and Tech to deliver end\-to\-end category initiatives.


 What you"ll be doing
   

  

 As the Head of Categories, you will take full ownership of Mumzworld's product portfolio strategy and financial performance across the UAE and KSA markets. On a day\-to\-day basis, you will drive top\-line growth and optimize profit margins while leading a high\-performing regional team of category managers and merchandisers. You will act as the primary commercial engine—sourcing global brands, negotiating exclusive partnerships, and designing pricing structures that convert. Beyond the financials, you will collaborate closely with supply chain teams to ensure perfect inventory availability, and partner with the digital UX team to ensure our bilingual platform offers a seamlessly curated, discoverable shopping experience for millions of families.
   

  

**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Experience: Minimum 8–12 years in category management, merchandising, or retail, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership role owning a multi\-million dollar P\&L.
* E\-Commerce Acumen: Proven track record in digital retail, marketplace, or omni\-channel environments. Deep familiarity with the UAE and KSA e\-commerce landscape is essential.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field; an MBA is highly preferred.
* Analytical Skillset: Highly proficient in utilizing data, metrics, dashboards, and financial modeling to drive forecasting and trend analysis.
* Language: Professional fluency in English is required; an Arabic bilingual advantage is highly valued.


 Why Us
   

  

 Join Mumzworld to lead a high\-impact category function in a fast\-growing regional market leader and shape the future of family e\-commerce in the Middle East.

**About Jumeirah** 




 Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art\-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.
 



  





**About the Job** 




 An exciting opportunity has arisen for a
 **Director – Wellness Operations** 
 to join
 **Jumeirah Group \& Corporate.** 








 The main duties and responsibilities of this role include:
 


* Lead the commercial performance of Jumeirah’s Wellness \& Spa portfolio, overseeing full P\&L responsibility across spa, retail, membership, and wellbeing programmes.
* Partner closely with the VP of Wellbeing to shape brand strategy and develop impactful annual wellness campaigns aligned with Jumeirah’s positioning.
* Drive global wellness initiatives and partnerships, enhancing brand visibility and strengthening Jumeirah’s presence in the luxury wellbeing space.
* Translate wellness strategy into performance excellence by managing KPIs, budgets, and operational standards, ensuring alignment with marketing and brand campaigns.
* Lead operational excellence across all wellness offerings, continuously elevating guest experience, treatment menus, and service standards to achieve LQA and Forbes benchmarks.
* Inspire, develop, and build a world\-class wellness team, overseeing recruitment, training, and capability development to deliver a consistently exceptional guest journey.



  





**About You** 




 The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
 


* Minimum 10 years of experience in a senior wellness leadership role within international luxury hospitality, managing wellness brands or multi\-site operations.
* Proven track record in designing, innovating, and elevating wellness programmes to enhance guest experience and commercial performance.
* Strong leadership experience, with the ability to inspire, develop, and lead high\-performing wellness teams.
* Deep expertise in integrated wellness concepts, with hands\-on experience delivering impactful training and development programmes.
* Background in wellness brand development, marketing, and pre\-opening environments, with a strong understanding of luxury positioning.



  









**About the Benefits** 




 At Jumeirah, we are dedicated to fostering a workplace where colleagues feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow. Our benefits package reflects this commitment by combining rewarding financial incentives, comprehensive healthcare, and opportunities for professional development.
 



  





 Benefits include:
 


* Supportive and inclusive work environment
* Access to Learning \& Development programmes and clear career pathways
* Opportunities for internal mobility within our global network
* Colleague discounts on food, beverage, and hotel stays worldwide
* Comprehensive healthcare and life insurance coverage
* Paid annual leave entitlement
* Incentive programmes aligned with leadership performance
* Competitive tax\-free salary paid in UAE Dirhams (AED)

**Profile Summary**
* Act as a core member of the Portfolio Management Team, with primary responsibility for portfolio management activities, including balance sheet optimization, capital efficiency, and portfolio\-level risk management across the MEA portfolio.
* Lead and drive portfolio strategy and capital optimization initiatives, including asset recycling, secondary distribution, and structural balance sheet efficiency improvements.
* Contribute to the enhancement of portfolio transparency and decision ‑ making through the continuous improvement, maintenance and effective use of portfolio analytics, dashboards, and reporting tools.
* Execute robust and proactive post\-execution credit monitoring with a strong focus on early risk identification, structured escalation, and portfolio discipline.
* Serve as an independent credit quality assurance and checker function, working closely with Portfolio Management, Credit, Business, and Operations stakeholders to safeguard credit standards.


**Duties And Responsibilities**
**Portfolio Management \& Capital Optimization**
* Lead portfolio management initiatives aimed at optimizing balance sheet usage and capital efficiency across the MEA portfolio.
* Enhance and manage portfolio frameworks and metrics to support disciplined, repeatable capital allocation, recycling, and exit decisions at a portfolio level, with appropriate benchmarking.

* Lead and coordinate capital release and portfolio optimization activities, including structured solutions and secondary market approaches, in collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders.

**Operational Efficiency \& Portfolio Infrastructure**

* Lead the ongoing enhancement, maintenance and effective utilisation of regional portfolio management dashboards to improve transparency, monitoring, and decision ‑ making.
* Support clearer ownership, standardized procedures, and stronger controls across portfolio ‑ related middle office activities.

* Ensure rating renewals are completed accurately and in full compliance with internal policies, coordinating with relevant stakeholders to prevent delays or omissions.

**Credit Quality Assurance \& Checker Role**
* Act as a primary checker and quality gatekeeper for credit applications, rating applications, loan agreement checklists, execution checklists, and related credit documentation submitted by Credit team.

**Job Summary**
 We are excited to invite applications for the role of
 **Discretionary Portfolio Management (DPM) \& Managed Investment (MI) Specialist** 
 within our Private Banking and Wealth Solutions division based in Dubai. This senior role demands an experienced and driven professional with an in\-depth understanding of Managed Investments and Discretionary Portfolio Management, capable of elevating our product offerings and strengthening client engagement across ultra\-high\-net\-worth individuals and family offices.
   

  

 The successful candidate will lead the advisory and distribution efforts of a comprehensive suite of managed funds and portfolios, providing expert insights and technical comparisons to empower Relationship Managers and clients in making well\-informed investment decisions. Additionally, you will play a crucial role in expanding our DPM business, fostering strong collaboration with Relationship Managers to deliver tailored investment solutions, ensuring regulatory compliance, and enhancing the overall client experience.
   

  

 This is an exceptional opportunity for a motivated individual who wishes to make a significant impact within a prestigious international bank, contributing to the growth and prominence of our Private Banking services in the dynamic Dubai market.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Product Leadership**
* Develop, implement, and continuously refine the Managed Investments product strategy in alignment with regional priorities to achieve targeted growth in assets under management, revenue, and client acquisition.
* Spearhead innovation by assessing market trends and client needs, leading the introduction of new Mutual Funds, DPM solutions, and Alternative Investments while ensuring stringent adherence to regulatory frameworks.
* Collaborate closely with marketing and sales teams to design and execute tailored campaigns that effectively communicate the value proposition of our products to both internal teams and clients.


**Business Development \& Growth**
* Proactively identify prospective clients in collaboration with Relationship Managers, delivering expert knowledge to support successful pitching and onboarding processes for DPM services.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and key consultant for Managed Investments and DPM, equipping the sales force with comprehensive product training and market insights.
* Monitor competitive landscape and regulatory developments to inform product positioning and strategic adjustments.


**Client Engagement \& Servicing**
* Lead ongoing portfolio reviews and client dialogues to ensure investment strategies remain aligned with individual financial goals, risk tolerance, and market conditions.
* Respond promptly to client inquiries and collaborate cross\-functionally to address issues, thereby enhancing client satisfaction and loyalty.
* Ensure compliance and best practice governance across all Managed Investments and DPM activities.


**Competencies And Skills**
* Action\-Oriented: Takes initiative to deliver results and overcome obstacles.
* Collaborative: Works effectively across teams and fosters a culture of mutual support.
* Customer Focus: Prioritises client needs and delivers exceptional service.
* Provides Clear Guidance: Communicates effectively, ensuring clarity and understanding.
* Manages Ambiguity: Adapts to changing environments and makes informed decisions despite uncertainty.
* Develops Talent: Coaches and supports colleagues to promote growth and capability building.
* Visionary Thinking: Aligns team efforts with strategic goals and future market trends.
* Continuous Learner: Demonstrates agility in acquiring new knowledge and skills.
* Decision Quality: Makes sound decisions based on data, experience, and analysis.
* Courage and Integrity: Acts ethically and stands firm on principles.
* Builds Trust: Establishes credibility and fosters strong professional relationships.
* Technical Expertise: Mastery of investment management principles, portfolio construction, risk assessment, and asset allocation strategies relevant to Managed Investments and DPM offerings.


**Our Ideal Candidate**
 The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience and a proven track record in managed investments and discretionary portfolio management, particularly within a Private Banking environment.
   

  

* Experience: At least eight years in Managed Investments, with substantial exposure to DPM sales or portfolio management targeted at ultra\-high\-net\-worth clients and family offices.
* Educational Background: A university degree in finance, economics, or a closely related discipline is required; industry certifications such as CFA or equivalent are highly desirable.
* Technical Proficiency: Deep knowledge of asset allocation, portfolio construction, risk management, and familiarity with both traditional and alternative investment vehicles.
* Personal Attributes: Self\-motivated with entrepreneurial drive, capable of shaping the role proactively to meet sales targets while fostering collaborative relationships with stakeholders across functions.
* Communication \& Influence: Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills to effectively convey complex investment concepts and drive client engagement and advisor alignment.
* Regulatory and Compliance Awareness: In\-depth understanding of financial regulations relevant to managed investments and the Private Banking landscape in the UAE.


**About Standard Chartered**
 Standard Chartered is a leading international banking group, combining a heritage of over 170 years with a forward\-looking approach to innovation and client service. Operating across Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, we are committed to driving commerce and prosperity through our diverse workforce and inclusive culture.
   

  

 Our organisation is built on strong values that promote integrity, continuous improvement, and collaboration. We cherish our diversity and strive to create an environment where every colleague feels empowered to bring their authentic self to work, contributing unique perspectives to drive our shared success.
   

  

 Joining Standard Chartered means becoming part of a global family united by a purpose to make a meaningful impact in the communities we serve and a commitment to ethical banking practices. We continuously invest in developing our people and adopting technologies to stay at the forefront of the financial services industry.
   

  

**What We Offer**
**Employee Benefits and Wellbeing**
 Aligned with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a comprehensive and competitive package designed to support your overall wellbeing and career development.
   

  

* Financial Security: Competitive salary complemented by essential benefits including retirement savings plans, medical and life insurance coverage, with additional flexible and voluntary benefits tailored to location\-specific needs.
* Work\-Life Balance: Generous leave entitlements encompassing annual leave, extensive parental/maternity leave (up to 20 weeks), sabbatical options for personal growth, and volunteering leave to give back to society.
* Flexible Work Arrangements: Opportunities for hybrid working patterns, balancing home and office presence to support individual productivity and wellbeing.
* Wellbeing Support: Access to Unmind, a leading digital wellbeing platform, comprehensive mental health resources, resilience training, employee assistance programmes, and mental health first\-aiders among the team.
* Continuous Learning: Encouragement and resources for upskilling and reskilling, including physical, virtual, and digital learning opportunities to foster career advancement.
* Inclusive Culture: Commitment to diversity and inclusion creating a respectful workplace where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

**Regional Industry Manager, FIG, MCA**
 Job \#: req37151
   

  

 Organization: IFC
   

  

**Sector**

 Recruitment Type: International Recruitment

 Required Language(s): English
   

  

**Preferred Language(s)**
 Closing Date: 6/27/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC
   

  

**Description**
 IFC — a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), is the largest global development institution focused on the private sector in emerging markets. We work in more than 100 countries, using our capital, expertise, and influence to create markets and opportunities in developing countries. In fiscal year 2025, IFC committed a record $71 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries, leveraging private\-sector solutions and mobilizing private capital to create a world free of poverty on a livable planet. For more information, visit www.ifc.org
   

  

 IFC is seeking a Regional Industry Manager for its Financial Institutions Group (FIG) investment activities in the Middle East, Pakistan and Afghanistan. The position is based in Dubai and will report to the Regional Industry Director, FIG Middle East \& Central Asia.
   

  

 The Regional Industry Manager will be responsible for leading business development, transaction processing, and portfolio management for FIG investment activities in the region. She/he will also coordinate on a continuous basis with IFC’s Regional Directors, Country Managers, the Middle East \& Central Asia FIG Leadership Team, World Bank Group (WBG) Knowledge Bank Financial Services Sector (FSS) and other Regional Managers, as well as other relevant departments/divisions within IFC, such as Special Operations (CSO), Treasury, Legal, Risk, the Equity Desk, Environmental \& Social, etc.
   

  

**Duties And Accountabilities**
* Develop the strategy for IFC’s FIG in the region, in partnership with the regional and industry management and relevant WBG colleagues, including key business goals for the FIG regional investment program, with a focus on high impact projects and in line with WBG Country Partnership Frameworks.
* Coordinate with the Upstream and Advisory services teams in implementing the FIG strategy for the Middle East, Pakistan and Afghanistan.
* Build and maintain high\-level relationships with clients in the region, understand sector trends, lead multidisciplinary teams to turn leads into deals that effectively balance IFC’s additionality, sustainable development impact, opportunity for innovation as well as scalability, and financial risks and rewards.
* Lead FIG business development efforts in the sub\-region, together with the regional/country teams and WBG Knowledge Bank FSS teams, ensuring high level of client satisfaction and program delivery within impact and profitability targets.
* Actively manage profitability for the FIG business in the sub\-region, with strong revenue and net income generation for long\-term financial sustainability.
* Assume the Transaction Manager role and provide operational guidance to teams ensuring rigorous quality control on teams’ output.
* Work with Regional Industry Managers in the Infrastructure and Natural Resources (INR) and Manufacturing‚ Agribusiness, and Services (MAS) departments to explore areas of joint ventures to expand IFC’s business.
* Foster relationships with WBG counterparts to identify collaboration opportunities and to enhance business delivery at the country and regional levels.
* Ensure portfolio experience and perspective is fed into strategy development and business decision making, through sharing of lessons learned from the portfolio, producing benchmarking analytics, etc.
* Report on the profitability and development impact of the portfolio and actively seek ways to optimize usage of economic capital and profitability performance, through sales, risk sharing or mobilization.
* Monitor the overall risk of the debt portfolio, ensure reviews of all active projects are completed on time and to the highest quality standard, and make recommendations on the appropriate level of specific loan loss reserves.
* Actively manage the entire equity portfolio, both core and non\-core, ensuring equity management plans are developed and adhered to for all assets, including proposing and filling board seats with qualified candidates for strategic assets.
* Regularly review valuations, write\-downs, exit strategies of the equity book, and develop a plan to sell less strategic assets to free up resources.
* Provide early warning for assets at risk and actively communicate with relevant colleagues regarding both debt and equity watch lists, ensuring close coordination with CSO and other Risk counterparts on rescheduling and restructuring situations.
* Supervise compliance with IFC financial, environmental, legal, and other requirements.
* Lead and manage the unit and ensure the team is high\-performing, well\-motivated, and committed to the advancement of IFC’s strategic goals.
* Be part of, and actively contribute to, the regional leadership team and the WBG Knowledge Bank FSS teams.
* Mentor and develop FIG staff in the sub\-region.
* Provide the full range of administrative and HR Management oversight.


 Selection Criteria
   

  

* Master's degree in business, finance or equivalent qualification.
* Minimum 12 years of relevant experience in the financial sector.
* Strong sense of service to clients, with strong track record in developing client relationships and processing quality investments.
* Deep knowledge of capital markets.
* Proven experience sourcing and structuring complex investment transactions.
* Demonstrated ability to think strategically, develop innovative solutions, challenge the status quo, and make sound decisions to build IFC business.
* Sound knowledge of portfolio/asset management and experience in portfolio supervision of loans, equities and guarantees, and restructurings and recovery of impaired assets.
* Ability to work in the matrix as an integral part of the Regional Department, delivering high quality work within tight deadlines and meeting team objectives.
* Proven experience in managing and developing teams.
* Strong written and verbal communications skills.
* Meet the World Bank Group\-wide managerial competencies: Courage of your Convictions, Leading the Team for Impact, Influencing Across Boundaries, Fostering Openness to New Ideas, Building Talent for the Future.


**WBG Culture Attributes**
* Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.
* Thoughtful risk\-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
* Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.


 World Bank Group Core Competencies
   

  

 The World Bank Group offers comprehensive benefits, including a retirement plan; medical, life and disability insurance; and paid leave, including parental leave, as well as reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities.
   

  

 We are proud to be an equal opportunity and inclusive employer with a dedicated and committed workforce, and do not discriminate based on gender, gender identity, religion, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability.

***Summary:***





  





 The Associate Director – Community Management / Owners Association will lead the strategic and operational management of Owners Associations (OA) and residential communities across the portfolio. The role is responsible for ensuring exceptional community living standards, regulatory compliance, stakeholder engagement, financial stewardship, and the effective governance of Owners Associations in accordance with relevant laws and regulations.
 



  





***The Role***




  





 Community \& Owners Association Management
 


* Lead the establishment, transition, and ongoing management of Owners Associations across residential and mixed\-use developments.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable Owners Association regulations, governance frameworks, and community management standards.
* Develop and implement community management strategies that enhance resident satisfaction and asset value.
* Oversee the preparation and administration of OA meetings, board meetings, annual general assemblies, and related governance requirements.
* Support OA board members with operational, financial, and strategic decision\-making.



 Stakeholder Engagement
 


* Build and maintain strong relationships with homeowners, residents, investors, OA board members, and key stakeholders.
* Manage escalated resident concerns and ensure timely resolution of community\-related issues.
* Drive resident engagement initiatives, community events, and communication programs to foster a positive community environment.
* Act as the primary escalation point for community\-related matters.



 Operations \& Service Delivery
 


* Oversee community operations, facilities management performance, security, landscaping, housekeeping, and other service providers.
* Monitor service levels and ensure contractual obligations and KPIs are consistently achieved.
* Conduct regular site inspections and audits to maintain community standards and identify improvement opportunities.
* Ensure all communities operate in accordance with health, safety, and environmental standards.



 Financial Management
 


* Oversee annual community budgets, service charge planning, reserve fund forecasting, and financial performance.
* Review and monitor expenditures to ensure cost efficiency and financial sustainability.
* Collaborate with finance teams on budgeting, reporting, audits, and service charge collection strategies.
* Present financial reports and recommendations to OA boards and senior management.



 Regulatory Compliance \& Governance
 


* Ensure full compliance with local regulatory requirements and governing authorities.
* Maintain accurate records, governance documentation, and statutory filings.
* Monitor changes in legislation and industry best practices, ensuring communities remain compliant.
* Support dispute resolution and risk management processes where required.



 Team Leadership
 


* Lead, mentor, and develop Community Managers and associated teams.
* Establish performance objectives and ensure high levels of accountability and service excellence.
* Promote a customer\-centric culture focused on resident experience and operational excellence.



  





***Competencies***




  




* 10 years of experience in Community Management, Property Management, Owners Association Management, or Residential Asset Management.
* Minimum 5 years in a leadership role managing large\-scale residential or mixed\-use communities.
* Strong experience working with Owners Associations, homeowners' boards, and regulatory authorities.
* Experience within luxury residential developments or master\-planned communities is highly desirable.
