 through a single accountable team. Their mandate is to deliver predictable outcomes, optimize asset value, and reduce operational risk for operators.
   

  

**Fuel your passion**
 The
 **Integrated Commercial Director – Field Development** 
 is responsible for leading complex commercial and proposal activities for integrated upstream field development opportunities. The role develops commercial frameworks, supports customer negotiations, and ensures proposals and agreements deliver shareholder value while addressing technical, operational, financial, and contractual risks.
   

  

 This position requires strong E\&P business development experience, knowledge of upstream field development practices, and the ability to translate end\-to\-end technical development plans into fit\-for\-purpose commercial structures.
   

  

**As an Integrated Commercial Director \- Field Development, you will be responsible for:**
* Develop proposals; may negotiate with customers; ensure deals deliver shareholder value; drive competitive pricing. May include compiling and submitting required tender documentation.
* Handle complex products, services, and systems requiring technical knowledge and understanding of the environment where the products or systems will be used. Products and systems are client\-specific and require technical analysis and system design to fit client conditions.
* Lead the commercial structuring of integrated field development opportunities, including pricing, scope definition, contracting strategy, risk allocation, and customer value proposition.
* Apply knowledge of upstream development practices across geoscience and engineering disciplines to support technically informed commercial solutions.
* Understand the technical context of end\-to\-end field development plans and develop accompanying commercial frameworks that support customer and business objectives.
* Manage complex long\-term sales processes. Contracts involve pricing and conditions of sales, rental, operation, maintenance, services, integrated solutions, and other field development\-related commercial arrangements.
* Support drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial agreements related to E\&P business development, including asset acquisition, joint operating agreements, commercial partnerships, and associated liabilities.
* Handle important business unit clients and senior customer interfaces.
* Coordinate sales teams involving engineering, legal, risk, finance, operations, product lines, and leadership.
* Participate in major sales and business development activities involving large, complex, or strategically important opportunities.
* Handle big or highly complex markets with large potential for growth.
* Ensure proposals and negotiated agreements comply with internal governance, risk management, approval processes, and shareholder value expectations.


**To be successful in this role you will:**
* Have a bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college.
* Have 10\+ years of experience working as a commercial advisor in an E\&P business development function.
* Have 10\+ years of experience drafting commercial agreements and negotiating terms related to asset acquisition, joint operating agreements, and associated liabilities.
* Have strong knowledge of upstream development practices across geoscience and engineering disciplines.
* Have the ability to understand the technical context of an end\-to\-end field development plan and structure an accompanying commercial framework.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance customer requirements, technical feasibility, contractual risk, and profitability.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse and resolve complex problems.
* Demonstrated ability to lead programs, projects, and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong negotiation skills with experience managing complex customer discussions and commercial agreements.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
   

  

  

* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive


**Working with us**
 Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well\-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
   

  

**Working for you**
 Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
   

  

  

* Contemporary work\-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
* Comprehensive private medical care options
* Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
* Tailored financial programs
* Additional elected or voluntary benefits


 The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Sales Director \- Proposals
   

  

**About Us:**
 We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
   

  

**Join Us:**
 Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.
   

  

 Baker Hughes Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

**About BeCurious**
 BeCurious is a premium Finnish\-method preschool operating across three branches in Kuwait — Salam, Shuhada, and Salwa. Built on the belief that curiosity drives learning, BeCurious combines a strong curriculum with a structured operating system.
   

  

 Each branch must operate at the same standard — every day, in every classroom. The Branch Manager is the person who makes that real on the ground.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Branch Manager owns the day\-to\-day operation of one BeCurious branch.
   

  

 This is not a coordination role. It is not administrative oversight. The Branch Manager ensures that every session, every teacher, and every family experience meets the BeCurious standard — consistently, without exception.
   

  

 You are responsible for execution. What is designed at system level must work in your branch — through people, discipline, and attention to detail.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Daily Operations — One Branch, Full Standard:
   

  

* Own the daily running of the branch from opening to closing.
* Ensure all sessions run on time and to standard.
* Execute all SOPs exactly as designed in the BeCurious OS.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and fully prepared environment at all times.
* Ensure readiness for inspections at any time.


**Team Management**
* Manage all teachers and support staff within the branch.
* Lead daily briefings and ensure team alignment.
* Hold staff accountable to performance standards.
* Support teacher development through coaching and feedback.
* Ensure no teacher leads a session without required training completion.


**Teaching \& Classroom Quality**
* Monitor classroom delivery daily.
* Conduct regular classroom observations.
* Ensure lesson plans and weekly planning are completed and followed.
* Ensure child observation records are completed properly.
* Maintain visible application of the Curiosity Lens Framework.


**Parent Experience**
* Ensure a high\-quality, consistent parent experience.
* Handle parent concerns professionally and promptly.
* Ensure proper communication standards are followed.
* Support tours and convert interest into enrollment in coordination with Admissions.


**Admissions Support**
* Support branch\-level enrollment targets.
* Ensure tour readiness and professional delivery.
* Follow up with prospective families when required.
* Maintain accurate information flow to the admissions system.


**Inventory \& Supplies**
* Monitor branch\-level inventory and usage.
* Coordinate with Purchasing Manager for supply needs.
* Ensure materials are available and organized for all sessions.
* Reporting \& Compliance.
* Report daily and weekly updates to Director of Operations.
* Maintain accurate records (attendance, incidents, staff data)
* Ensure incident reports are completed within required timelines.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements.


**What This Role Is Not**
* The Branch Manager does not operate without structure — SOPs are followed, not reinvented.
* This is not a passive supervisory role — you are actively managing every day.
* The Branch Manager does not avoid accountability conversations.
* This role is not about being liked — it is about maintaining standards.


**You Are The Right Person If**
 You will thrive in this role if you:
   

  

* Are highly organized and present on the floor.
* Can manage people with clarity and firmness.
* Pay attention to detail others miss.
* Take full ownership of outcomes, not excuses.
* Can maintain energy and consistency every day.


**This Role Is Not Right For You If You**
* Prefer planning over execution.
* Avoid difficult conversations with staff or parents.
* Struggle with structure and process discipline.
* Need constant direction instead of taking ownership.


**Required**
**Qualifications and Experience:**
* Minimum 3–5 years experience in education, preschool, or operations.
* Experience managing a team.
* Strong organizational and leadership skills.
* Arabic and English proficiency.
* Based in Kuwait or able to relocate immediately.


**Preferred**
* Experience in early childhood education.
* Experience in a structured, multi\-branch environment.
* Familiarity with school systems (Odoo, Brightwheel, etc.).


**What BeCurious Offers**
* A clear operating system — you execute with clarity, not guesswork.
* A real leadership role at branch level.
* Direct impact on children, families, and team quality.
* Growth as the organization expands.
* Compensation.
* Competitive, based on experience. Discussed at offer stage.


**How To Apply**
* Send your CV and a short note answering:
* “What does a high\-performing branch look like in a preschool, and how have you contributed to it?”
* Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

data.jd_text:
**Role Purpose**
 The Senior Manager – Internal Audit Centre of Excellence (IA CoE) is responsible for strengthening the Internal Audit function through quality assurance, strategic planning, methodology development, digital enablement, and centralized resource management.
   

  

 The role acts as the strategic and operational backbone of the Internal Audit Unit, ensuring consistency, efficiency, innovation, and alignment with Global Internal Audit Standards (IPPF), while enabling delivery of high\-quality assurance and advisory services. across the organization.
   

  

**Position Information**
* Unit: Internal Audit
* Division: CAE
* Location: HQ


**Grade:** 
 L2
   

  

**Qualification**
* Bachelor’s in accounting /finance /business or related subjects. CIA certification is a must.
* Professional certification including CA, CPA, ACCA, CISA, will be highly preferred.


**Experience**
* 8 years of total experience \& at least 3 years in a managerial position.


**Key Accountabilities**
 Quality Assurance \& Improvement Program
   

  

* Lead and manage the Quality Assurance \& Improvement Program (QAIP), develop and implement necessary quality assessment methodology, models, tools, etc.
* Ensure \& promote compliance with: IPPF / Global Internal Audit Standards, local regulations \& Internal audit methodology and policies.
* Perform ongoing internal quality assessment including individual engagement level assessments and implement improvements across the Unit.
* Conduct periodic quality reviews of Internal Audit Unit with respect to compliance with IPPF and local regulations.
* Facilitate external quality assessments.
* Identify improvement opportunities and drive continuous enhancement of audit quality.


 Performance Management
   

  

* Define and monitor KPIs and performance metrics for the Internal Audit function.
* Track audit delivery (Strategy \& Plan) against plans, timelines, and quality benchmarks.
* Support performance evaluation processes in coordination with audit leadership.
* Provide insights to CAE on productivity, utilization, and capability development.


 Risk Based Internal Audit Plan
   

  

* Coordinate development of the annual risk\-based internal audit plan after consolidating inputs from Business Units, Internal Audit teams, second line functions and Senior Management and Audit \& Risk Committee.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise risks, regulatory requirements, and strategic priorities and recommend adjustments in the plan where necessary.
* Monitor performance and delivery of audit engagement against the plan and produce MIS.


 Internal Audit Strategy
   

  

* Support the CAE in developing and monitoring of Internal Audit Strategy, initiatives and roadmap.
* Coordinate and where necessary implement strategic initiatives.


 Standardization \& Operational excellence
   

  

* Custodianship of IA manual and ensures IAU activities are in compliance with regulatory and Global IA standards.
* Continuously review, enhance, and update Internal Audit methodologies, frameworks, and processes to ensure alignment with best practices and drive operational excellence.
* Standardize audit approaches, templates, tools, and reporting formats across the function.
* Benchmark audit practices against leading industry standards and peers.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing and adoption of best practices across the function.


 Continuous Audit \& Digital Enablement
   

  

* Ensure the smooth delivery of continuous audit engagements and where possible coordinate to embed the output in the planned audit engagements.
* Enable and support audit teams through data analytics and automation.
* Ensure the digital enablement of the Unit (including use of emerging tech like AI) as per the IA Strategy.
* Oversee administration of the Audit Management System, including System configuration and enhancements, User access and governance and Integration of analytics and reporting capabilities
* Promote adoption of data\-driven auditing and digital tools across Internal Audit.


 Audit \& Risk Committee \& Executive Management Reporting
   

  

* Prepare and submit to CAE monthly, quarterly, semi\-annual and annual MIS and other lAU performance related reports, including follow up / findings dashboard, internal quality assessment reports, state of lA report, etc.
* Assist CAE in preparation and administration of BAC Meetings.
* Provide insights on audit plan status, Key findings and themes, open findings, risk exposures and trends.
* Support CAE in presentation materials and stakeholder communications.
* Prepare and coordinate delivery of various awareness sessions on GRC \& Ethics.


 Follow\-Up Coordination
   

  

* Coordinate follow up and validation efforts to ensure timely closure and update of findings status.
* Centralize tracking of Internal Audit findings and management action plans.
* Monitor and report status of overdue and high\-risk issues.
* Escalate critical matters to CAE and senior management.


 Whistleblower Program \& Investigations
   

  

* Manage and coordinate investigations under the Whistleblower Program.
* Ensure investigations are conducted objectively, confidentially, and in line with policies.
* Coordinate with Legal, HR, and Compliance where required.
* Ensure proper documentation, reporting, and closure of cases.


 Resource Management /Audit Pool Administration
   

  

* Manage the centralized Internal Audit resource pool (\~20 staff). Schedule Audit engagements and serve as a focal point for consolidating individual engagement level assessment and leave management of the pool staff.
* Allocate resources to audit teams (GMs/SMs) based on audit priorities, skill requirements, capacity and utilization
* Oversee scheduling, utilization, and workforce planning.
* Manage administrative aspects including ERP\-related matters, timesheets, and coordination.


 Subsidiaries Audit Management \& Contract Governance
   

  

* Manage procurement and onboarding of outsourcing vendors for Internal Audit of unlisted subsidiaries in line with governance requirements.
* Coordinate closely with the appointed external audit service providers, Management of subsidiaries and respective GM Internal Audit to effectively plan, execute, and monitor audit activities across subsidiaries.
* Ensure timely preparation and submission of audit dashboards and reports, including consolidation and escalation of key findings, to the Board Audit \& Risk Committee.
* Monitor vendor performance against SLAs and handle administrative matters including invoice verification and accurate cost chargeback to subsidiaries.


**Key Competencies**
**Leadership**
* Assertiveness and Conflict Resolution
* Fostering Learning and Development
* Inspiring and Leading Others
* Leading Change and Cultivates Innovation
* Visioning and Alignment


**Behavioral**
* Timely decision\-making
* Drives Achievements
* Ethics \& Compliance

 The MARSA LNG Bunkering Project aims to establish a regional LNG bunkering hub supplying LNG as a marine fuel. The project is part of the company’s energy transition strategy and will be supplied by equity gas from the Greater Barik field (Block 10\).

* Conduct Technical Training Needs Analysis (TNA) and competency gap assessments
* Design, develop, and maintain technical training programs, syllabi, and course materials
* Implement competency\-based training frameworks for engineers, technicians, and operators
* Develop and deliver OJT (On\-the\-Job Training) systems and apprenticeship programs
* Ensure compliance with LNG regulations, industry standards, and HSE requirements
* Establish training KPIs, metrics, and performance monitoring systems
* Manage training records, assessments, and certification tracking systems
* Oversee training budgets, resource planning, and roster scheduling
* Liaise with regulatory bodies for course approvals and compliance
* Coordinate external training providers, vendors, and certification bodies
* Lead coaching, mentoring, and succession planning programs
* Support development of HSE training matrices and promote safety culture
* Manage training contracts from tendering through execution and lifecycle


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (mandatory for immigration)
* 10–12\+ years of experience in LNG or oil \& gas operations
* Minimum 5 years’ experience in technical training and competency development
* OPITO Certified Assessor (required)
* Train\-the\-Trainer (TOT) certification (required)
* Strong experience in competency frameworks, technical assessments, and gap analysis
* Proven ability in designing and delivering technical/OJT training programs
* Knowledge of LNG regulations, HSE standards, and industry best practices
* Experience managing training systems, KPIs, and reporting frameworks
* Strong leadership, coaching, and cross\-functional collaboration skills
* Excellent English communication (written and spoken)
* Experience working with contractors, vendors, and regulatory stakeholders


 Additional Information
   

  

* Duration: 12 months
* Renewable: Yes
* Location: Muscat (Oman) with frequent visits on sites

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
Own the backlog for a national platform, turning product vision and roadmap into a prioritized, build ready stream of work your squad ships sprint after sprint.
 



 RQMNA builds the sovereign platforms that turn national digital ambitions into services millions of citizens use every day.
 



  





 We are hiring a Senior Product Manager, on site in Muscat, to own the backlog and drive delivery for a major area of national platforms.
 



  





 What you'll do: Own the backlog, turn the roadmap into prioritized, build ready work, and steer your squad to ship it.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Own and prioritize the product backlog for one or more delivery squads, aligned to the product roadmap and vision
* Translate strategy and roadmap into clear epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria the team can build
* Be the team's daily voice of the product: answer questions, make trade off calls, and unblock decisions fast
* Order the backlog ruthlessly by value, and decide what is in and out of each sprint
* Accept or reject completed work against acceptance criteria, and own the definition of done with the team
* Run backlog refinement, sprint planning, and reviews alongside the Scrum Master and engineering
* Gather and manage requirements across government entities, and turn conflicting asks into one ordered backlog
* Track delivery against outcomes, and continuously reprioritize as you learn



  





 What makes you a fit:
 


* You have owned a real product backlog and driven a squad to ship working software, not just managed a tracker
* You write crisp user stories and acceptance criteria, and you slice work so teams can actually deliver it
* You prioritize by value, and you are comfortable saying no and deferring the rest
* You are decisive in the room, so the team gets fast, clear answers from you
* You partner well with engineering and design, and with the Product Manager who owns the roadmap above you
* You manage demanding stakeholders without letting the backlog become a wish list
* You hold a Bachelor's or higher in a relevant field; CSPO, PSPO, or SAFe POPM certifications are a plus
* Bonus points for government, regulated, or platform and multitenant products
* Fluent English required; Arabic is a valuable advantage



  





 If you turn vision into shipped software, sprint after sprint, own the backlog here. Apply.

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a Project Manager to manage and support the delivery of software and digital transformation projects for the Oman Ministry of Education. The role will be responsible for coordinating project activities, following up with internal teams, managing stakeholders, tracking progress, and ensuring successful delivery within the agreed scope, timeline, and quality standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage the end\-to\-end delivery of software projects, from planning and requirements gathering to execution, monitoring, and go\-live.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams including Business Analysts, Developers, QA, UI/UX Designers, and implementation teams.
* Act as the main point of contact between internal teams, stakeholders, partners, and the client.
* Track project progress, timelines, risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Prepare and maintain project plans, status reports, meeting minutes, and follow\-up actions.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure clear communication across all project parties.
* Identify project risks and support in preparing mitigation plans.
* Ensure project deliverables are aligned with business requirements and quality expectations.
* Support resource planning and task prioritization with technical and business teams.
* Use project management tools such as Jira, MS Project, or similar tools to track tasks and deliverables.


**Qualifications \& Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

* Experience in education, government, or large\-scale implementation projects is preferred.
* Good understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum project delivery is preferred.
* Experience using project tracking tools such as Jira, MS Project, Trello, Asana, or similar tools.
* Good technical understanding of software platforms, integrations, cloud solutions, or modern development environments.
* Strong communication, coordination, follow\-up, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and work under pressure.

**Required Experience**
 Minimum 4 years of experience in project management, preferably in software, EdTech, government, or digital transformation projects.

data.jd_text:
**Purpose / Mission:**
 Establish and operate the project's document control system across all engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning phases of the 2\.5 Mtpa green Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) / Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) plant in Duqm, Oman. Maintain the integrity, accessibility and traceability of all project documents exchanged between the owner's team, the technology licensor, the integrated delivery partner, lenders, regulatory authorities and other counterparties.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Establish, configure and operate the project's electronic document management system, covering all engineering, contractual, commercial, regulatory and HSE documentation.
* Define and enforce document numbering, revision control, status coding and approval workflows across the owner's team and external counterparties.
* Receive, log, distribute and track all incoming and outgoing project documents, including transmittals to and from the technology licensor, the integrated delivery partner, equipment vendors, lenders' independent technical advisors and Omani authorities.
* Maintain the project's master document register and ensure all document holders are working from current revisions.
* Manage the document approval cycle, ensuring timely turnaround between submission, review, comment and approval status across all disciplines.
* Support the preparation of document packages for major project milestones, including Final Investment Decision, lender due diligence, regulatory submissions and project financial close.
* Maintain the project's electronic and physical archive in line with the company's records retention policy and lender requirements.
* Support the discipline lead engineers and the Project Director with document retrieval, status reporting and audit trail evidence as required.
* Establish handover procedures for as\-built documentation from construction into operations.


**Requirements / Skills / Experience:**
* Minimum 8 years' experience as a Document Controller on large heavy industrial capital projects, with at least one project of capex value USD 500 million or above.
* Demonstrated experience operating an electronic document management system across multi\-party project environments involving owner, EPC contractors and technology licensors.
* Familiarity with industry\-standard document numbering and classification systems used in oil and gas, petrochemicals, steel or power projects.
* Experience supporting project finance lender due diligence and audit processes is preferred.
* Middle East or GCC project delivery experience strongly preferred. Prior experience in Oman is an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational discipline and ability to maintain document integrity under high transaction volumes.
* Effective communication skills with engineering, commercial and external stakeholders.
* Ability to work within a small owner's team where each individual carries direct responsibility for their function.
* This position is open to Omani nationals only.


**Required Education / Qualification / Training:**
* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Management, Business Administration or related discipline (required).
* Certification in document control, records management or project information management (e.g., AIIM, IRMS) (preferred).
* Proficiency in industry\-standard document management platforms (e.g. Aconex, ProjectWise, SharePoint, EDMS).


**Required Language Proficiency:**
 English \- Fluent
   

  

 Arabic \- Nice to have

data.jd_text:
**Purpose / Mission:**
 Develop, integrate and maintain the project's master schedule across all phases from pre\-FID through commissioning of the 2\.5 Mtpa green Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) / Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) plant in Duqm, Oman. Provide the Project Director, the company executive and the project's lenders with the integrated schedule view that supports decision\-making, risk management and financial close.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Develop and maintain the project's master schedule, integrating inputs from the technology licensor, the integrated delivery partner, equipment vendors, utility providers, port authorities and Omani regulatory counterparties.
* Consume and integrate the technology licensor's pre\-engineering Level 2 schedule and the integrated delivery partner's FEED and execution schedules into a single owner's master schedule.
* Manage interface dates and critical path dependencies across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, utility connections, port readiness and regulatory approvals.
* Maintain the project schedule baseline and track progress against baseline through earned value or equivalent reporting methods.
* Lead schedule risk analysis, including critical path analysis, float consumption tracking, and schedule contingency assessment.
* Prepare schedule reports for internal review, lender reporting and external stakeholder engagement, including the Project Director, the company executive, the lender consortium, and equity investors.
* Support the project's cost estimate development by providing schedule\-driven inputs into resource and cost loading.
* Support the project's risk management process by identifying schedule risks and supporting mitigation planning.
* Provide planning support to the discipline lead engineers in their interactions with the integrated delivery partner and equipment vendors.
* Maintain alignment between the project schedule and the project's regulatory, permitting and contractual milestones.


**Requirements / Skills / Experience:**
* Minimum 12 years' experience in project planning and scheduling on large heavy industrial capital projects, with at least one project of capex value USD 500 million or above.
* Direct experience on greenfield projects in steel, ironmaking, petrochemical, oil and gas, fertilizer or power.
* Demonstrated experience integrating multi\-party schedules across owner, technology licensor, EPC contractors and equipment vendors.
* Strong understanding of critical path methodology, schedule risk analysis and earned value management.
* Proficiency in industry\-standard scheduling software (Primavera P6 required; MS Project an advantage).
* Experience supporting project finance lender due diligence on schedule deliverables is strongly preferred.
* Middle East or GCC project delivery experience strongly preferred. Prior experience in Oman is an advantage.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to communicate schedule status and risk to senior executive and lender audiences.
* Ability to work within a small owner's team where each individual carries direct responsibility for their function.
* This position is open to Omani nationals only.


**Required Education / Qualification / Training:**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management or related discipline (required).
* Master's degree in Project Management, Construction Management or related field (preferred).
* Project Management Professional (PMP), AACE Planning \& Scheduling Professional (PSP), or equivalent professional certification (preferred).
* Primavera P6 certification (preferred).


**Required Language Proficiency:**
 English \- Fluent
   

  

 Arabic

data.jd_text:
**Purpose / Mission:**
 Develop, validate and maintain the project's capital cost estimate across the pre\-FID and FEED phases of the 2\.5 Mtpa green Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) / Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) plant in Duqm, Oman, to a level of accuracy sufficient to support Final Investment Decision and lender due diligence. Provide independent owner\-side cost estimating, quantity surveying and commercial assurance across the technology package, the integrated delivery partner's scope, and the broader project capex.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Develop and maintain the project's capital cost estimate, integrating inputs from the technology licensor, the integrated delivery partner, equipment vendors, port and utility infrastructure providers, and the owner's team.
* Triangulate, challenge and validate cost estimates produced by the technology licensor and the integrated delivery partner, providing independent owner\-side commercial assurance.
* Develop and maintain the project's bill of quantities for civil, structural, mechanical, piping and electrical scopes within the owner's review responsibility. Lead cost estimating accuracy improvement from order\-of\-magnitude through Class 3 to Class 2 estimates aligned with AACE International recommended practice and lender expectations.
* Support the project's procurement strategy by developing should\-cost analyses, market price benchmarks and cost\-driver analyses for major equipment and construction packages.
* Maintain the project's cost contingency framework, including identification of cost risks, quantification of contingency requirements and reporting against contingency drawdown.
* Support the project's value engineering process by quantifying cost impacts of design alternatives and providing commercial input into engineering trade\-off decisions.
* Support project finance lender due diligence by preparing cost estimate documentation packages and engaging directly with independent cost consultants engaged by the lender consortium.
* Provide cost reporting to the Project Director, the company executive and external stakeholders including lenders and equity investors.
* Support post\-FID cost control and change management by establishing the cost baseline, change control framework and earned value reporting structure.


**Requirements / Skills / Experience:**
* Minimum 12 years' experience in quantity surveying, cost estimating or cost engineering on large heavy industrial capital projects, with at least one project of capex value USD 500 million or above.
* Direct experience developing FID\-grade and lender\-grade cost estimates aligned with AACE International recommended practice (Class 3 or better).
* Direct experience on greenfield projects in steel, ironmaking, petrochemical, oil and gas, fertilizer or power.
* Demonstrated experience providing independent owner\-side cost validation against contractor or licensor cost estimates.
* Familiarity with FIDIC\-based contracting, lump\-sum cost build\-ups, and reimbursable cost frameworks.
* Experience supporting project finance lender due diligence on cost estimate deliverables is strongly preferred.
* Middle East or GCC project delivery experience strongly preferred. Prior experience in Oman is an advantage.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to communicate cost status and risk to senior executive and lender audiences.
* Ability to work within a small owner's team where each individual carries direct responsibility for their function.
* This position is open to Omani nationals only.


**Required Education / Qualification / Training:**
* Bachelor's degree in Quantity Surveying, Cost Engineering, Construction Management, Engineering or related discipline (required).
* Master's degree in Cost Engineering, Project Management or related field (preferred).
* Member of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (MRICS) or AACE International Certified Cost Professional (CCP) (preferred).
* AACE Planning and Scheduling Professional (PSP) or Estimating Professional (EVP) certification (preferred).


**Required Language Proficiency:**
 English \- Fluent
   

  

 Arabic \- Nice to have

data.jd_text:
**Position** 




 Chief Financial Officer
 



**Location** 




 Muscat, Sultanate of Oman, with regular travel to project sites as required.
 



**Reporting Line** 




 Reports to the CEO / Board of Directors.
 



**Company** 




 Its a Oman\-based mining and environmental services company focused on sustainable resource recovery, mine tailings remediation, acid mine drainage treatment, and the transformation of low\-grade ore and legacy mining waste into valuable resources including copper, gold, silver, and other metals.
 



 The company is entering an important growth phase, with multiple current and planned projects requiring disciplined financial leadership, strong project finance capability, robust governance, and hands\-on commercial oversight.
 



**Role Purpose** 




 The CFO will be expected to work closely with the Board, General Manager, project teams, technical teams, shareholders, lenders, auditors, and external advisors to ensure that each project is financially viable, properly funded, well controlled, and aligned with the company’s long\-term strategy.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Financial Strategy \& Leadership** 



* Develop and lead the company’s financial strategy in line with its growth plans, project pipeline, and shareholder objectives.
* Provide strategic financial advice to the Board and senior management on business expansion, capital allocation, project prioritization, and investment decisions.
* Build a finance function capable of supporting a growing, project\-based organization.
* Establish financial policies, processes, reporting structures, and decision\-making frameworks suitable for a scaling business.



**Project Finance \& New Project Evaluation** 



* Lead financial planning and analysis for new and existing projects, including feasibility models, project budgets, funding requirements, cash flow forecasts, and return assessments.
* Develop and maintain detailed project financial models covering CAPEX, OPEX, working capital, production assumptions, commodity pricing, financing costs, and sensitivity scenarios.
* Support project teams in assessing commercial viability, project risks, procurement costs, operating costs, and expected returns.
* Monitor project performance against approved budgets, milestones, and business cases.
* Provide early warning on budget overruns, funding gaps, cost escalation, or project delays.



**Budgeting, Forecasting \& Cash Flow Management** 



* Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and long\-range financial planning.
* Manage company\-wide cash flow with a strong focus on project funding needs, procurement commitments, payroll, supplier payments, and working capital.
* Implement cash flow discipline across the organization.
* Ensure that project teams have accurate financial information to make timely decisions.
* Track actual performance against budget and forecast, explaining variances and recommending corrective action.



**Financial Reporting, Controls \& Governance** 



* Oversee accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, corporate governance requirements, and local regulations.



  





**Commercial \& Operational Support** 



* Partner with project, operations, procurement, legal, and technical teams to support commercial decision\-making.
* Review contracts, supplier agreements, EPC/procurement commitments, offtake arrangements, and major commercial terms from a financial risk perspective.
* Support pricing, cost recovery, margin analysis, and project profitability reviews.



**Risk Management** 



* Identify and manage financial risks related to project execution, commodity prices, funding, foreign exchange, taxation, insurance, working capital, and contractual commitments.
* Develop risk mitigation plans and ensure financial risks are visible to management and the Board.
* Maintain strong compliance, governance, and ethical standards across the finance function.



**Required Experience** 



* Significant senior finance leadership experience, preferably as CFO, Finance Director, Head of Finance, or equivalent.
* Proven experience in a growing, project\-based, capital\-intensive business.
* Demonstrated ability to manage the finances of new projects, not only ongoing operations.
* Strong experience in project finance, financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, and capital planning.
* Experience working with banks, investors, shareholders, lenders, auditors, and external advisors.
* Strong understanding of CAPEX management, project controls, procurement commitments, and working capital requirements.



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field; CPA, CA, ACCA, CFA, CMA, or MBA preferred.
* 12\+ years of progressive finance experience, including senior leadership experience in mining, natural resources, industrial, infrastructure, or capital\-intensive businesses.
* Strong expertise in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, reporting, audit, tax, treasury, and internal controls.



**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate has worked in companies that were expanding, building new assets, raising capital, launching projects, or scaling operations. They will be comfortable operating in an environment where priorities change, projects require active financial input, and the CFO is expected to be both strategic and hands\-on.
 



**Success Measures** 



* Strong financial control across all projects and corporate activities.
* Reliable project financial models and forecasts.
* Timely funding availability for approved projects.
* Clear visibility on cash flow, project costs, and financial risks.
* Improved Board and shareholder reporting.
* Strong internal controls and governance.
* Finance function capable of supporting continued growth.
* Commercially sound investment and project decisions.



**Application** 




 Interested candidates should submit their CV, and relevant professional qualifications.

SUMMARY OF ROLE:
   





 The Unit Head \- Transaction Banking is responsible for leading the strategy, growth, and end\-to\-end delivery of transaction banking services, including cash management, payments, and trade finance. The role focuses on driving revenue growth, enhancing client experience, ensuring regulatory compliance, and delivering innovative, technology\-driven solutions to corporate and institutional clients. The role holder will also lead cross\-functional collaboration to position the Bank as a leading provider of transaction banking solutions in the market.
   





  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
   





 Responsibilities
   





 Strategy Development \& Execution
   





 • Define and implement the Transaction Banking strategy aligned with the Bank’s overall Corporate Banking and growth objectives.
   





 • Identify market opportunities, industry trends, and competitive positioning to enhance the Bank’s transaction banking offerings.
   





 • Develop and execute business plans to expand product penetration and increase market share.
   





  




 Revenue Growth \& Financial Performance
   


 • Drive revenue generation through effective pricing strategies, product optimization, and cross\-selling initiatives.
   





 • Achieve assigned financial targets including fee income, CASA growth, and transaction volumes.
   





 • Monitor profitability of transaction banking products and optimize cost\-to\-income ratios.
   





  




 Product Management \& Innovation
   


 • Oversee the development, enhancement, and lifecycle management of transaction banking products including cash management, payments, and trade finance.
   





 • Ensure products remain competitive, customer\-centric, and aligned with market needs.
   





 • Lead the introduction of innovative and digital solutions to enhance product capabilities and client experience.
   





  




 Client Relationship Management
   


 • Build and maintain strong relationships with key corporate and institutional clients.
   





 • Ensure high levels of client satisfaction through efficient service delivery and tailored solutions.
   





 • Support relationship managers in structuring transaction banking solutions to meet client requirements
   





  




 Sales \& Business Development
   


 • Lead and support sales initiatives to acquire new clients and expand existing client portfolios.
   





 • Work closely with Corporate Banking teams to drive product penetration and cross\-selling opportunities.
   





 • Participate in client meetings, pitches, and strategic discussions to position the Bank’s offerings effectively.
   





  




 Digital Transformation \& Process Optimization
   


 • Champion digital banking initiatives, automation, and process improvements within transaction banking.
   





 • Collaborate with IT and Digital teams to implement innovative solutions and enhance operational efficiency.
   





 • Drive straight\-through processing (STP) and reduce manual interventions across processes.
   

  

  

  




 Requirements
   

  


 • Omani Nationals Only
   





 • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Banking, Business Administration, or related field.
   





 • Minimum 7 years of banking experience, with at least 5 years in Transaction Banking or Corporate Banking roles.

 The role acts as the owner’s representative throughout the asset lifecycle, overseeing business performance, revenue optimization, operational efficiency, capital planning, leasing strategies, investment returns, and stakeholder management. The Asset Manager is accountable for asset\-level and portfolio\-level P\&L performance, ensuring assets achieve their strategic, financial, and operational objective.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**




**Asset Performance \& P\&L Management** 



* Assume full responsibility for asset\-level financial performance and profitability.
* Develop and manage annual business plans, operating budgets, and financial forecasts.
* Monitor revenue, operating expenses, EBITDA, NOI, cash flow, and asset valuation metrics.
* Identify and implement initiatives to improve asset profitability and value creation.
* Conduct regular financial and operational performance reviews and recommend corrective actions where necessary.
* Establish performance targets and KPIs for individual assets and portfolio segments.



**Portfolio Management** 



* Manage a diverse portfolio of real estate and infrastructure assets across various asset classes.
* Develop portfolio optimization strategies to maximize risk\-adjusted returns.
* Evaluate asset hold, repositioning, redevelopment, refinancing, acquisition, and disposal opportunities.
* Monitor market trends, competitive positioning, and emerging opportunities affecting portfolio performance.
* Support strategic portfolio planning and capital allocation decisions.



**Commercial \& Revenue Optimization** 



* Lead initiatives to enhance revenue generation and asset utilization.
* Oversee leasing performance, tenant mix strategies, occupancy optimization, and rental growth initiatives.
* Assess commercial opportunities including new revenue streams, partnerships, sponsorships, and ancillary income.
* Work closely with leasing, sales, hospitality, and operations teams to maximize asset performance.



**Business Planning \& Investment Analysis** 



* Prepare detailed financial models and investment analyses.
* Conduct feasibility assessments for capital improvements, redevelopment projects, and strategic initiatives.
* Evaluate investment returns using NPV, IRR, ROI, payback, and other financial metrics.
* Support acquisition, divestment, and restructuring decisions through comprehensive financial and commercial assessments.



**Capital Projects \& Asset Enhancement** 



* Identify asset enhancement opportunities to improve value, customer experience, and operational performance.
* Oversee capital expenditure planning and prioritization.
* Monitor implementation of approved enhancement projects and track return on investment.
* Coordinate with development and project management teams to ensure alignment with asset strategies



**Operations Oversight** 



* Collaborate with property management, facilities management, hospitality operators, and service providers.
* Monitor service standards, operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and asset condition.
* Ensure assets are maintained to required quality, safety, and regulatory standards.
* Review operating contracts and service agreements to ensure value for money.



**Stakeholder Management** 



* Serve as the primary owner representative for assigned assets.
* Manage relationships with operators, tenants, investors, consultants, government entities, and strategic partners.
* Present asset performance reports and recommendations to executive management and boards.
* Facilitate alignment between asset strategy, operations, finance, and development teams.



**Governance, Risk \& Compliance** 



* Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, contractual obligations, and corporate governance requirements.
* Identify and mitigate operational, financial, and market risks.
* Maintain robust reporting, controls, and performance monitoring frameworks.
* Support internal and external audit requirements.



  





**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**




  




* Bachelor’s degree in real estate, Finance, Investment, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or related discipline.
* Master's degree (MBA, Real Estate, Finance, or Investment Management) preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in asset management, real estate investment, portfolio management, hospitality, infrastructure, or related sectors.
* Demonstrated experience managing diverse asset classes and complex stakeholder environments.
* Proven track record of delivering strong financial and operational performance.
* Experience with large\-scale mixed\-use developments and destination assets is highly desirable.

data.jd_text:
The Manager / Senior Manager – Portfolio \& Asset Management will support the execution of Asyad Group’s portfolio management function. The role will focus on driving asset\-level performance visibility, detailed financial and operational analysis, value creation planning, turnaround support, and capital efficiency across Asyad’s portfolio companies and strategic investments.
 



 The role requires a strong analytical profile, preferably with significant Financial Due Diligence experience, and the ability to work closely with business units, finance teams, operating companies and senior management to identify performance gaps, challenge assumptions, and support value creation initiatives.
 



  





**Performance Monitoring \& Business Plan Review** 



* Monitor performance against budget across revenue, EBITDA, cash flow and capex, and flag key risks and variances.
* Prepare monthly/ quarterly structured asset review packs and performance dashboards for management and board reporting.
* Identify early warning signals and track implementation of corrective actions.
* Review and challenge annual business plans, budgets and forecasts submitted by portfolio companies.
* Validate key assumptions and assess alignment with strategy and value creation objectives.
* Evaluate capex plans and expected returns to support capital allocation decisions.



  





**Financial Analysis** 



* Perform detailed analysis of financial performance, covering revenue, margins, cost structure, working capital, cash generation and capital efficiency.
* Assess sustainability of earnings and identify key performance gaps and drivers.
* Build and maintain asset\-level financial models to support performance tracking and decision making.



  





**Value Creation \& Turnaround** 



* Identify and prioritize value creation opportunities across growth, cost optimization, asset utilization and cash improvement.
* Support turnaround of underperforming assets through structured action plans and performance tracking.
* Quantify impact of initiatives and monitor delivery against targets.



**Governance \& Shareholder Oversight** 



* Prepare shareholder materials, portfolio reviews and performance summaries for internal stakeholders.
* Track board resolutions, shareholder actions and key governance matters across portfolio companies.
* Identify governance, reporting and control gaps and escalate where required.



**Capital \& Strategic Support** 



* Assess capital structure, funding requirements, returns and capital efficiency across assets.
* Support follow\-on investments, restructuring initiatives and divestment analysis.
* Contribute to portfolio\-level capital allocation and strategic review discussions



  





**Skills** 



* Hands\-on and analytical with strong FDD and financial analysis capability.
* Ability to challenge numbers, assumptions and business plans.
* Strong Excel and financial modelling skills.
* Ability to convert detailed analysis into clear management recommendations.
* Commercial judgment and ability to link operational drivers to financial performance.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with ability to work across business units and portfolio companies.
* High attention to detail and ability to work with incomplete or inconsistent data.
* Clear written communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to operate independently and manage multiple assets/workstreams.



 English language is mandatory. Fluent in Arabic preferred.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or related field.
* Professional qualification preferred: CPA, ACCA, CFA, ACA or equivalent.
* MBA or advanced finance qualification is an advantage.



**Experience** 



* Minimum 8 to 10 years of experience in Financial Due Diligence / Transaction Services, private equity, portfolio management or corporate finance.
* Strong experience in financial analysis, business performance review and working with management accounts.
* Demonstrable strong financial modelling experience.
* Extensive knowledge of financial accounting concepts and corporate finance.

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The incumbent will lead in a proactive and prudent fashion the Bank’s treasury function by managing the Bank’s cash flows, asset – liability profile and foreign exchange exposures/risk and generate supplementary income within the set strategy, risk appetite, applicable regulatory limits and approved products.
   

  

 Manages activity of the trading team by implementing the defined Group Risk Management Framework in which they operate. Develops and actively pursues cross\-border trading opportunities and developing a strategy to grow the business. Has thorough knowledge of a broad range of trading techniques including trading/hedging strategies (stack and roll, cross commodity), market liquidity and volatility, options, derivatives, futures, swaps, exotics pricing and trading, and has broad understanding of commodity markets. Has extensive background in risk management strategies and is responsible for ensuring that overall value and risk exposure of the trading portfolio remains within the agreed Group strategy.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Oversees the development and implementation of annual business plans and target budgets for units of responsibility with emphasis on achievement of set targets/ objectives, business growth and expansion; in accordance with the Bank’s overall budget and strategy.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate activities/ authority to the respective staff as required and monitor exercise of the same.
* Approves formulated, and/or specific strategies which cover balance sheet asset, liability and contingent allocation, longer term funding arrangements asset diversification, use of market products and financial instruments with risks identified, and hedging, trading and investment strategies.
* Oversees the implementation and evaluation of the Treasury strategic and business development plans and achievement of related short and long term business goals both locally and internationally.
* Approves Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) created for the purpose of performance monitoring and quality measurement purposes for the Treasury function and monitor their achievements on periodic basis.
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for role
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
* Approves Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turnaround time (TAT) which will also help increase external customer satisfaction.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal auditors, the Compliance function, and Group Risk as and when required.
* Meets with visiting banks representatives, and maintains credit lines and services through active relationship management.
* Establishes and oversees the management of relationships with key internal and external stakeholders and managing key client interface.
* Provide feedback to Corporate/Retail Banking business units’ managers and, as appropriate, recommend course of action.
* To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationship with all other related departments and units to achieve the Group’s goals/objectives.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal auditors and the Compliance function as and when required.


**Education/Experience Requirements**
* University graduate preferably with a Major in Finance, Banking, Economics, or Mathematics (related field of study), Masters preferred.
* MBA, CFA, ACT or related professional certification is preferable.
* 15 years diverse Treasury experience, of which 5 years must have been in a leading role in a Treasury Division, preferably in the country or with an international bank.
* Additional commercial banking experience, especially credit and market risk management would be of value.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV

data.jd_text:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
   

  

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**Background and Context**
 Digital \& Technology sits at the heart of Haleon’s ambition to Win as One. We are Haleon’s digital backbone – how we accelerate impact, unlock new value, and build a future‑ready organisation. Digital isn’t simply part of our business; it is how we operate, grow, and deliver everyday health at scale.
   

  

 The Digital \& Technology function plays a critical role as a strategic partner to the business, turning insights into impact and ideas into innovation. From secure, resilient operations and modern digital foundations, to hyper‑personalised customer and consumer experiences, digital is embedded across every part of Haleon – shaping how we innovate, supply consumer demand, go to market, and run our internal operations.
   

  

 Our focus is clear: to secure the business, run resilient and compliant operations, and transform Haleon into a digital organisation that is wired for excellence. This is enabled by sustained investment in a scalable, resilient technology foundation and the adoption of digital solutions that empower our people, elevate performance, and enable the 4–6% organic revenue growth and productivity savings underpinning Win as One.
   

  

 Digital only delivers when people are at the centre. Building skills, confidence, and modern ways of working is essential to realising value from technology. Together, we are reshaping the backbone of Haleon to become a best‑in‑class consumer health company – bold, resilient, performance‑focused, and fit for the future.
   

  

**Role Overview**
* The Senior OU Tech Partner (UAE) is a senior Organisational Unit (OU) Digital \& Technology partner accountable for delivering business\-critical digital capabilities that enable commercial growth and operational excellence across the MEA OU.
* The role is responsible for the day\-to\-day delivery and operational management of digital and technology capabilities supporting Haleon’s OU priorities in the MEA. Acting as the primary technology partner to OU business leaders, this role ensures digital priorities are translated into reliable, scalable solutions aligned to global platforms and standards.
* The focus is on execution excellence, adoption, operational performance, and measurable business impact, rather than enterprise or regional strategy ownership.
* The role requires experience delivering digital capabilities across sales, marketing, eCommerce, and digital platforms, alongside operational technologies such as infrastructure and security.
* Combining strong commercial understanding with execution leadership, the Senior OU Tech Partner owns end\-to\-end delivery, adoption, and performance of digital initiatives, while ensuring alignment with Haleon’s global roadmaps, governance, and ways of working.
* Success in this role is driven by delivery excellence, business impact, stakeholder leadership, and the ability to operate effectively within a complex, matrixed global environment.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Delivery \& Execution**
* Deliver agreed digital and technology initiatives supporting OU priorities in the MEA.
* Translate defined roadmaps and plans into clear delivery activities, milestones, and outcomes.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery accountability for key OU initiatives, ensuring measurable business outcomes (e.g. growth, productivity, adoption).
* Coordinate and lead delivery across internal teams, global platform partners, and vendors
* Coordinate delivery across internal teams, global platform partners, and vendors to ensure timely execution.
* Track progress, risks, and dependencies, escalating issues proactively.


**Business \& Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Work closely with OU Marketing, Sales, Customer, and Corporate teams to clarify requirements and support delivery.
* Partner with commercial leaders to align digital initiatives with market growth priorities, ensuring technology investments deliver tangible business value.
* Bring strong understanding of commercial drivers (sales execution, distribution, customer engagement, eCommerce) into solution delivery.
* Act as the primary day‑to‑day technology contact for assigned domains or initiatives.
* Build strong working relationships with business stakeholders to enable adoption and value realisation.


**Matrix \& Global Collaboration**
* Partner with global product, engineering, and platform teams to deliver MEA OU requirements in line with global standards.
* Contribute delivery feedback and local insights to support continuous improvement of global platforms and services.


**Governance, Risk \& Compliance**
* Ensure delivery activities follow secure‑by‑design principles and established architecture standards.
* Apply global IT governance, risk, and compliance frameworks within assigned scope.
* Support compliance with local regulatory, data privacy, and security requirements.


**Operations \& Financial Management**
* Monitor operational performance of owned digital and technology services and support issue resolution with global teams.
* Support budget tracking, vendor coordination, and benefits tracking for assigned initiatives.


**Team \& Capability Contribution**
* Lead cross\-functional delivery teams and workstreams across markets, global platform teams, and vendors.
* Provide direction, prioritisation, and decision support across complex initiatives.
* Act as a senior point of escalation for delivery, adoption, and performance challenges.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 10\+ years’ experience in digital, technology, or commercial technology roles, including leadership of complex delivery initiatives.
* Experience delivering digital capabilities across sales, marketing, eCommerce, CRM, or digital experience platforms.
* Experience working in a matrixed, global organisation, partnering with central product and platform teams.
* Exposure to technology operations, vendors, or delivery partners.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Clear communicator, able to engage both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Experience in CPG, retail, or consumer‑led environments advantageous.


**Job Posting End Date**
 2026\-06\-30
   

  

**Equal Opportunities**
 Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
   

  

 During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
   

  

 The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
   

  

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
 If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
   

  

**Note to candidates**
 The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

data.jd_text:
KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end\-to\-end services to take clients from inspiration – through conceptualization – to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 60 years we’ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world’s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities.
 



  





 As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the \#1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey.
 



  





 We invite you to join us. Why?
 



  





 When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company\-wide health and well\-being through on\-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun\-runs, in\-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 Our newest opportunity is for a talented Cloud and Infrastructure Platforms Director to to join our award\-winning team based in Dubai, UAE.
 



  





 This critical leadership role is responsible for defining, delivering, and managing the organization’s enterprise cloud, infrastructure, and platform strategy across regional and international operations. The successful candidate will lead the modernization of IT infrastructure, cloud adoption, cybersecurity resilience, digital workplace technologies, and enterprise platform services to support a rapidly growing construction consultancy business.
 



  





 The role requires a highly experienced technology leader with a strong background in hybrid cloud environments, enterprise infrastructure operations, IT governance, cybersecurity, and large\-scale transformation initiatives within complex, multi\-site organizations.
 



  





 We envisage success in this role to include;
 



  





**Strategic \& Platform Leadership** 




  




* Define and execute KEO's cloud\-first, platform\-first infrastructure strategy, leading the evolution from traditional operations toward a modern platform engineering model that enables self\-service, automated, and product\-oriented infrastructure capabilities.
* Manage and continuously improve service reliability at enterprise scale, owning KEO's infrastructure performance and availability posture in alignment with digital transformation goals and business priorities.



  





**Cloud \& Platform Engineering** 




  




* Own and evolve KEO's Microsoft Azure environment, leading the design, deployment, and lifecycle management of IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS platforms through cloud\-native architectures, infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC), and platform engineering principles to ensure scalability, security, cost\-optimization, and developer agility.
* Oversee identity and access management via Microsoft Entra ID, enforcing MFA, RBAC, and least\-privilege principles, and manage KEO's zero\-trust network architecture ensuring access is granted only through verified identity, context, and policy.
* Maintain certified digital platforms \- including Microsoft SharePoint and Autodesk Construction Cloud \- to their respective security and governance standards.
* Drive cloud cost optimization initiatives \- including right\-sizing, reserved capacity management, and workload scheduling \- to maximize return on cloud investment.



  





**Cybersecurity \& Digital Trust** 




  




* Champion KEO's cybersecurity posture across all infrastructure and platform operations, overseeing Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM) for real\-time threat detection, automated response playbooks, and rapid incident management, alongside cloud security posture management (CSPM) for continuous assessment and remediation of misconfigurations and vulnerabilities.
* Ensure zero\-trust, least\-privilege, and access control governance principles are consistently applied and independently verified via EY audits, and lead KEO's phishing simulation programme to drive continuous improvements in security awareness.
* Maintain and continuously improve Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) programmes \- including automation of recovery workflows, regular testing, and audit\-readiness \- with appropriate escalation to IT leadership and executive oversight.



  





**Modern Service Management** 




  




* Lead a shift from traditional ITIL\-process orientation toward experience\-driven, outcome\-based service management, owning service reliability engineering practices including SLAs, SLOs, and error budgets across all platforms.
* Lead continuous service improvement cycles, platform lifecycle governance, and technology refresh programmes, ensuring all operations adhere to KEO's IT governance standards, security policies, regulatory requirements, and green IT sustainability commitments.



  





**Automation, DevOps \& SRE Mindset** 




  




* Champion an automation\-first culture, leading the implementation of infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipeline integration, self\-service cloud provisioning, and zero\-touch operations to eliminate manual processes at scale.
* Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles \- including error budgets, reliability targets, and blameless post\-incident reviews \- to drive continuous improvement in platform deployment velocity, reliability, and recovery time.



  





**Data\-Driven \& AI\-Enabled Operations** 




  




* Lead the adoption of observability platforms and AIOps tooling to enable predictive performance monitoring, anomaly detection, and automated incident response, driving responsible AI adoption to enhance infrastructure efficiency, intelligent capacity planning, and proactive operations
* Use operational telemetry and data\-driven insights to inform platform investment decisions and continuous improvement initiatives, staying at the forefront of AI\-driven infrastructure operations and edge computing to evaluate and recommend adoption pathways aligned to KEO's strategy.



  





**Team Leadership \& People Development** 




  




* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing, geographically distributed infrastructure team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Set clear goals, provide regular feedback, and champion professional growth and certification of each team member.
* Build a psychologically safe team environment where automation innovation, constructive challenge, and knowledge sharing are actively encouraged.
* Promote cross\-functional collaboration with Digital Workplace, Enterprise Digital Solutions, and Technology Strategy teams to ensure “one IT” delivery



  





**Qualifications** 




  





 To be successful in this dynamic opportunity, we envision that your career journey to date will include 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, including a minimum of 3–5 years in a leadership capacity managing teams, cloud platforms, or enterprise infrastructure operations. You will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or possess an equivalent combination of education and over 10 years of relevant professional experience.
 



  




* Proven, hands\-on experience managing Microsoft Azure cloud environments at enterprise scale, including hybrid cloud architecture, identity, and security services.
* Demonstrated experience leading a shift from traditional infrastructure management to modern platform engineering and DevOps\-aligned operations.
* Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD for infrastructure, self\-service cloud provisioning, and zero\-touch operations.
* Experience applying Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, including error budgets, SLOs, and blameless post\-incident review practices.
* Proven cloud financial management (FinOps) experience: cost optimization, chargeback models, consumption governance, and cloud cost dashboards.
* Deep expertise in cybersecurity operations: Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM), zero\-trust architecture, cloud security posture management (CSPM), Entra ID / Azure AD, and endpoint security.
* Experience managing third\-party governance and audit review processes.
* Familiarity with AI\-driven infrastructure operations, edge computing architectures, and platform product models.
* Experience in the AEC (Architecture, Engineering, and Construction) or professional services sector is advantageous.
* Understanding of sustainable/green IT infrastructure principles and their application to cloud operations.



  





 KEO’s performance is founded upon integrity, results, innovation, safety and our people. We embrace diversity and recognise its’ contribution to client success wherever we work.
 



  





 We are excited to hear how you can partner with our award\-winning team and treat all expressions of interest confidentially.
